a: Lehu: hezid bishvuat happikkadon vehitru bo, mahu? kevan dechiddush hu – divchol hattora la ashkechan mezid demayyte korban, vehacha mayyte korban – la shena atro beh vela shena la atro beh? o dilma, hane mille hecha dela atro beh; aval hecha deatro beh – milka lake, korban la mayyte; o dilma, ha veha avdinan.

Amaru leh, tenena: chamura hemenna shevuat happikkadon, shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah asham bechesef shekalim. middekaamar leh al zedonah makkot – mikkelal deatro beh; vekaamar makkot in, korban la.
Umay chumera? denicha leh leinish demayyte korban vela lilke.
Amar lehu rava bar ittay: man tana zedon shevuat happikkadon lo nittan lechappara – rabbi shimon; aval lerabbanan – korban name mayyte.

Amar lehu rav kahana: bar minna dehahi; daana tanena la – vehachi tanena la: echad zedonah veechad shiggatah, asham bechesef shekalim. umay chumera? deillu hatam chattat bat danka, vehacha asham bechesef shekalim.
Veligmar minna! dilma dela atro beh.
Lishshana acharina, ta shema: en chayyayvin al shiggatah. ma hen chayyayvin al zedonah? asham bechesef shekalim. may, lav bidatro beh? hacha name dela atro beh.

Ta shema: lo; im amarta benazir tame – shekken loke; tomar bishvuat happikkadon – sheeno loke?! middekaamar loke – mikkelal deatro beh; vekaamar tomar bishvuat happikkadon sheeno loke – aval korban mayyte!
May eno loke – deeno niftar bemalkot. mikkelal denazir tame niftar bemalkot?! ha "korban" ketiv beh! hatam demayyte korban ki hechi detechul aleh nezirut betohora.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derabba. amar lehu: mikkelal dechi la atro beh veikka edim – michayyayv?! kefirat devarim bealma hu! alma kasavar rabba: hakkofer bemamon sheyyesh alav edim – patur.
Amar leh rav chanina lerabba, tanya dimsayyay lach: "vechichesh bah" – perat lemode leechad min haachin o leechad min hashshuttafin. "venishba al shaker" – perat lelove bishtar ulelove beedim.
Amar leh: i mishshum ha – la tesayyeyan; beomer "laviti, velo laviti beedim", "laviti, velo laviti bishtar".

Mimmay? middekatane "vechichesh bah" – perat lemode leechad min haachin o leechad min hashshuttafin. hay leechad min haachin hechi dame? illema deodi leh befalga dideh – ha ikka kefira deiddach! ella lav deamri leh: mittarvenan yezaft; vaamar lehu: la, mechad minnayychu yezafi – dehavya leh kefirat devarim bealma? umidderesha kefirat devarim – sefa name kefirat devarim.
(Siman – chova; kittot; devaal habbayit; chomer; nezira) ta shema: eno chayyayv al shiggatah. umahu chayyayv al zedonah? asham bechesef shekalim. may, lav zedon edim? la, zedon atzmo.

Ta shema: hayu shete kitte edim, kafra harishona veachar kach kafra hashsheniyya – shetehen chayyayvot, mippene sheyyechola edut lehitkayyem bishtehen. bishlama sheniyya tichayyayv – deha kafra lah kat rishona; ella rishona ammay michayyeyva?
b: Ha kayyma sheniyya!

Amar ravina: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta sheniyya bishat kefirat harishona kerovin binshotehen, uneshotehen gossot. mahu detema: rov gossin lemita; ka mashma lan: hasheta mihat chaye ninhu vela shechive.

Ta shema: baal habbayit shettaan taanat gannav befikkadon, venishba, vehoda, uvau edim; im ad shello bau edim hoda – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham. im mishshebbau edim hoda – meshallem tashlume chefel veasham!
Hacha name, kidravina.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, ta shema: chamura mimmenna shevuat happikkadon – shechayyayvin al zedonah makkot, veal shiggatah asham bechesef shekalim. middekaamar loke – mikkelal deikka edim; vekaamar: al shiggatah asham bechesef shekalim!
Amar lehu rav mardochay: bar minna dehahi; dehaamar lehu rav kahana: ana tenena la – vehachi tenena la: echad zedonah veechad shiggatah, asham bechesef shekalim.

Ta shema: lo; im amarta benazir tame – shekken loke; tomar bishvuat happikkadon – sheeno loke?! hechi dame? i delekka edim – ammay loke? ella peshita deikka edim; vekatane: tomar bishvuat happikkadon sheeno loke; milka hu dela lake – aval korban mayyte; teyuveta derabba! teyuveta.
Rabbi yochanan amar: hakkofer bemamon sheyyesh alav edim – chayyayv. bishtar – patur. amar rav pappa: may tameh derabbi yochanan? edim – avidi demayyti, shetar – ha mannach.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: shetara name avid demirchas! ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hayeynu tameh derabbi yochanan – mishshum dehave shetar shibud karkaot, veen meviin korban al kefirat shibud karkaot.

Ittemar: mashbia ede karka – peligi rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar; chad amar chayyayv, vechad amar patur. tistayyaym derabbi yochanan deamar patur – middeamar rabbi yochanan: hakkofer bemamon sheyyesh alav edim – chayyayv, shetar – patur; vechidrav huna bereh derav yehoshua. tistayyaym.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi avahu: lema rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbanan ka mippalgi? ditnan: haggozel sade mechavero ushetafah nahar – chayyayv lehaamid lo sade. divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: omer lo "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Veamrinan: bemay kamippalgi? rabbi eliezer daresh ribbuye umiute, verabbanan darshi kelale uferate.
Rabbi eliezer daresh ribbuye umiute: "vechichesh baamito" – ribba, "befikkadon o vitsumet yad" – miet, "o mikkol asher yishshava" – chazar veribba.
Ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol. may ribba? ribba kol mille; umay miet? miet shetarot.

Verabbanan darshi kelale uferate: "vechichesh baamito" – kelal, "befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel" – perat, "o mikkol asher yishshava alav" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat.

Ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon; af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon. yatzu karkaot – sheen (mittaltel) [mittaltelin]; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon.
Man dimchayyev – kerabbi eliezer, uman defatar – kerabbanan.
Amar leh: la; man dimchayyev – kerabbi eliezer; uman defatar amar lach: beha afillu rabbi eliezer mode, derachamana amar "mikkol" – velo hakkol.

Amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: "ganavta et shori", vehu omer: "lo ganavti"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen" – chayyayv. veillu "ganavta et avdi" – la katane; may tama? lav mishshum deeved ittakkash lekarkaot, veen meviin korban al kefirat shibud karkaot?
Amar rav pappe mishshemeh derava: ema sefa, ze hakkelal: kol hameshallem al pi atzmo – chayyayv, vesheeno meshallem al pi atzmo – patur. "ze hakkelal" leetoye may? lav leetoye "ganavta et avdi"?

a: Ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Shevuat happikkadon ketzad? "ten li pikkadon sheyyesh li beyadcha" kulei. tanu rabbanan: kelal – eno chayyayv ella achat. perat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: "shevua lo lecha velo lecha velo lach" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Rabbi eliezer omer: "lo lecha velo lecha velo lecha, shevua" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyomar shevua lechol achat veachat.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kelalo shel rabbi meir – perato shel rabbi yehuda; kelalo shel rabbi yehuda – perato shel rabbi meir.

Verabbi yochanan amar: hakkol modim bivlo lach" – shehu perat; lo nechleku ella belo lach" – sherabbi meir omer perat, verabbi yehuda omer kelal. veezehu kelalo shel rabbi meir? "shevua sheen lachem beyadi".

Bemay kamippalgi? shemuel dayek mibbarayyta, verabbi yochanan dayek mimmatnitin. shemuel dayek mibbarayyta: middekaamar rabbi yehuda "velo lach" perata have – mikkelal deshameh lerabbi meir deamar kelala have, vaamar leh rabbi yehuda: perata have.
Verabbi yochanan amar: tarvayyhu lerabbi meir perata have; vaamar leh rabbi yehuda: bivlo lach" modena lach, belo lach" peligna alach. ushemuel – ad deodi leh odoye, liflog aleh ippeloge!

Verabbi yochanan dayek mimmatnitin – middekaamar rabbi meir: "shevua sheen lachem beyadi" – kelala have, mikkelal divlo lach" – perata have; dei salka datach "velo lach" kelala have – addemashma lan "shevua sheen lachem beyadi", nashmeinan "shevua lo lach velo lach velo lach", kol shekken "shevua sheen lachem beyadi"!
Ushemuel amar: kol haomer "velo lach", keomer "shevua sheen lachem beyadi" dame.
Tenan: "lo lach velo lach velo lach"! teni: "lo lach".
Ta shema: "ten li pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda"! teni: "tesumet yad gazel aveda".
Ta shema: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin"! teni: "seorin kussemin".
Vehay tanna kol hachi shavesh tane veazel?! ella ha manni – rabbi hi, deamar: la shena "kezayit, kezayit", vela shena "kezayit uchezayit" – perata have.
Ta shema middideh: rabbi meir omer, afillu "chitta useora vechussemet" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. teni: "chitta seora kussemet".
May "afillu"? amar rav acha bereh derav ika: afillu chitta bichlal chittin, useora bichlal seorin, vechussemet bichlal kussemin.
"Ten li pikkadon utesumet yad gazel vaaveda sheyyesh li beyadcha" kulei. "ten li chittin useorin" – amar rabbi yochanan: peruta mikkullam mitztarefet.
Peligi ba rav acha veravina – chad amar: apperate michayyayv, akkelale la michayyayv; vechad amar: akkelale name michayyayv.
Vehatane rabbi chiyyay: hare kan chamesh esre chattaot; veim ita – esrim havyayn! hay tanna – difrate ka chashev, dichlale la ka chashev.
Veha tane rabbi chiyyay: "hare kan esrim chattaot"! hahi appikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: hayu chamishsha tovin oto, veamru lo: "ten lanu pikkadon tesumet yad vegazel vaaveda sheyyesh lanu beyadcha"; amar leechad mehen: "shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon tesumet yad gazel vaaveda, velo lach velo lach velo lach velo lach" – mahu? achada michayyayv,
b: O dilma akkol chada vachada michayyayv?
Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: hare kan esrim chattaot. hechi dame? i defaresh – rabbi chiyyay minyana ata leashmoinan? ella lav dela paresh – ushema minna perata have?
Anasta ufittita et bitti kulei. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? hoil veikkar kenas hu tovea.

Amar rava: mashal derabbi shimon, lema haddavar dome? leadam sheamar lachavero: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha", amar lo: "shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittin"; veishtechach dechittin hu delet leh, ha seorin vechussemin it leh – defatur; dechi ishteva achittin – akkusheta mishteva.

Amar leh abbaye: mi dame?! hatam – bechittin ka chafar leh, bisorin vechussemin la ka chafar leh. hacha – bechulla milleta hu deka chafar leh! ha la damya ella leomer lachavero: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha", "shevua sheen lecha beyadi kelal"; veishtechach chittin hu delet leh, ha seorin vechussemin it leh – demichayyayv!

Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre rabban shimon – kenas hu tovea, velo boshet ufegam; ledivre chachamim – af boshet ufegam hu tovea. bemay ka mippalgi? amar rav pappa, rabbi shimon savar: la shavek inish midde dekitz, vetava midde dela kitz. verabbanan savri: la shavek midde dechi mode beh la mippetar, vetava midde dechi mode beh mippetar.
Hadaran alach shevuat happikkadon
Mishna shevuat haddayyaynin – hattaana shete kesef, vehahodaa beshave peruta. veim en hahodaa mimmin hattaana – patur.
Ketzad? "shete kesef li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella peruta" – patur. "shete kesef uferuta li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella peruta" – chayyayv.
"Mane li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi" – patur. "mane li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim dinar" – chayyayv.
"Mana leabba beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim dinar" – patur, mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda.
"Mane li beyadcha", amar lo "hen"; lemachar amar lo: "tenehu li", "netattiv lach" – patur. "en lecha beyadi" – chayyayv.
"Mane li beyadcha", amar lo "hen"; "al tittenehu li ella beedim", lemachar amar lo "tenehu li", "netattiv lach" – chayyayv, mippene shetztzarich litteno beedim.

"Litra zahav yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella litra kesef" – patur. "dinar zahav yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella dinar kesef uteresit ufunedayot uferuta" – chayyayv, shehakkol min matbea achat.
"Kor tevua li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella letech kitnit" – patur. "kor perot li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella letech kitnit" – chayyayv, shehakkitnit bichlal perot.
Teano chittin, vehoda lo bisorin – patur. verabban gamliel mechayyev.

Hattoen lachavero bechadde shemen, vehoda lo bekankannim – admon omer: hoil vehoda lo miktzat mimmin hattaana, yishshava. vachachamim omrim: en hahodaa mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.

Teano kelim vekarkaot; vehoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, bakkarkaot vechafar bakkelim – patur. hoda bemiktzat hakkarkaot – patur. bemiktzat hakkelim – chayyayv, shehannechasim sheen lahen achrayut zokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut lishshava alehen.
En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan, veen mashbiin et hakkatan; aval nishbain lakkatan velahekdesh.
Gemara hechi mashbeinan leh? amar rav yehuda amar rav: mashbiin oto bishvua haamura betora, dichtiv: "veashbiacha baAdonai elohe hashshamayim".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: keman – kerabbi chanina bar idi, deamar: baenan shem hameyuchad?
Amar leh: afillu tema rabbanan, deamri bechinnuy; venafka minna tzerich leatpose cheftza bideh.

Vechidrava – deamar rava: hay dayyayna deashba "baAdonai elohe hashshamayim" – naasa kemi shettaa bidvar mishna, vechozer. veamar rav pappa: hay dayyayna deashba bitfillin – naasa kemi shettaa bidvar mishna, vechozer.
Vehilcheta kevavteh derava, velet hilcheta kevavteh derav pappa. hilcheta kevavteh derava – deha la naket cheftza bideh; velet hilcheta kevavteh derav pappa – deha naket cheftza bideh.
Shevua meummad; talmid chacham – meyushshav. shevua besefer tora; talmid chacham – lechattechilla bitfillin.
Tanu rabbanan: shevuat haddayyaynin, af hi bilshonah neemra.
Omrim lo: heve yodea,

a: Shekkol haolam kullo nizdaza beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu besinay "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav".

Vechol averot shebbattora neemar bahen "venakke", vechan neemar "lo yenakke". vechol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto; shenneemar: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha" – veen besaro ella kerovo, shenneemar: "umibbesarcha lo titallam".
Vechol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umikkol haolam kullo; shenneemar: "alo vechachesh".
Veema ad deaved lehu lechullehu! la salka datach; dichtiv: "mippene ala avla haaretz", uchetiv: "al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah".

Vechol averot shebbattora – im yesh lo zechut, tolin lo shenayim ushelosha dorot; vechan nifrain mimmennu lealtar – shenneemar: "hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot, uvaa el bet haggannav veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker, velane betoch beto vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav".

"Hotzetiha" – lealtar. "uvaa el bet haggannav" – ze haggonev daat habberiyyot; sheen lo mamon etzel chavero, vetoano umashbio. "veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker" – kemashmao. "velane betoch beto vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav" – ha lamadta, devarim sheen esh umayim mechallin otan, shevuat sheker mechalla otan.

Im amar: "eni nishba" – potrin oto miyyad. veim amar: "hareni nishba" – haomdin sham omrim ze laze: "suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle vegomer". ucheshemmashbiin oto omrim lo: heve yodea, shello al datecha anu mashbiin otcha, ella al daat hammakom veal daat bet din.
Shekken matzinu bemoshe rabbenu, keshehishbia et yisrael, amar lahen: deu, shello al datechem ani mashbia etchem, ella al daat hammakom veal dati; shenneemar: "velo ittechem levaddechem vegomer".
"Ki et asher yeshno po" – en li ella otan haomdin al har sinay; dorot habbaim vegerim haatidin lehitgayyer – minnayin? talmud lomar: "veet asher enennu".
Veen li ella mitzva shekkibbelu alehem mehar sinay; mitzvot haatidot lehitchaddesh, kegon mikra megilla – minnayin? talmud lomar: "kiyyemu vekibbelu" – kiyyeymu ma shekkibbelu kevar.
May "af hi bilshonah neemra"?

Keditnan: ellu neemarin bechol leshon – parashat sota, vidduy maaser, keriat shema, utefilla, uvirkat hammazon, ushevuat haedut, ushevuat happikkadon. vekaamar name: shevuat haddayyaynin – af hi bilshonah neemra.

Amar mar, omrin lo: heve yodea, shekkol haolam kullo nizdaza beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu: "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav". may tama? illema mishshum deityehev besinay – eser dibberot name ityehev!
Veella mishshum dachamira – umi chamira?! vehatnan: ellu hen kallot – ase velo taase, chutz millo tissa". chamurot – zo karetot umitot bet din, velo tissa" immahen!
Ella kidkatane tama – vechol averot shebbattora neemar bahen "venakke", vechan neemar "lo yenakke".
Vechol averot shebbattora lo neemar bahen "lo yenakke"?! vehachtiv: "venakke lo yenakke"!

Hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi elazar – detanya, rabbi elazar omer: i efshar lomar "venakke" – shekkevar neemar "lo yenakke"; i efshar lomar "lo yenakke" – shekkevar neemar "venakke". ha ketzad? menakke hu lashshavim, veeno menakke lesheenan shavim.
Kol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto. vechol averot shebbattora mimmishpachto la?!

Vehachtiv: "vesamti ani et panay baish hahu uvemishpachto"; vetanya, amar rabbi shimon: im hu chata, mishpachto ma chatat? lomar lecha: en lecha mishpacha sheyyesh bah moches – sheen kullah mochsin; vesheyyesh bah listim – sheen kullah listim; mippene shemmechappin alav!

Hatam bedina acharina, hacha bedina dideh; kidtanya, rabbi omer: "vehichratti oto" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "vesamti ani et panay" – yachol kol hammishpacha kullah behikkaret? talmud lomar: "oto" – oto behikkaret, velo kol hammishpacha kullah behikkaret.

Vechol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umikkol haolam kullo; shenneemar: "alo vechachesh", uchetiv: "al ken teeval haaretz". veema ad deaved lehu lechullehu! la salka datach, dichtiv: "mippene ala avla haaretz".
Vechol averot shebbattora – mikkol haolam la?! vehachtiv: "vechashlu ish beachiv" – ish baavon achiv; melammed shekkol yisrael arevim ze baze!
b: Hatam sheyyesh beyadam lemachot, velo michu.
May ikka ben reshaim demishpachto larshaim dealma; ben tzaddikim demishpachto letzaddikim dealma?
Hu bishar averot – bedineh; ureshaim demishpacha – bedin chamur; ureshaim dealma – bedin hakkal; tzaddike dehacha vehacha – petiri.
Gabbe shevua, hu ureshaim demishpacha – kedineh; ureshaim dealma – bedin chamur; vetzaddike dehacha vehacha – bedin hakkal.

Im amar "eni nishba" – potrin oto miyyad, veim amar "hareni nishba" – haomdim sham omrim ze laze: "suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle". bishlama hahu deka mishteva – kae beissura; ella hahu deka mashba leh – ammay?
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi shimon ben tarfon omer: "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" – melammed shechala shevua al shenehem.
Ucheshemmashbiin oto, omrim lo: heve yodea shello al datecha vechulei. lema li lememra leh hachi? mishshum kanya derava.
Hattaana shete kesef. amar rav: kefirat taana shete kesef. ushemuel amar: taana atzmah shete kesef; afillu lo kafar ella bifruta, velo hoda ella bifruta – chayyayv.

Amar rava: dayka matnitin kevateh derav, ukerae kevateh dishmuel. dayka matnitin kevateh derav – dekatane hattaana shete kesef vehahodaa shave peruta, veillu kefirat taana peruta la katane. utenan name hahodaa bifruta, veillu kefira bifruta la katane.

Ukerae kevateh dishmuel – dichtiv: "ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor" – ma "kelim" shenayim, af "kesef" shenayim; ma kesef davar chashuv, af kol davar chashuv; vekaamar rachamana: "ki hu ze".
Verav – hahu mibbee leh lehodaa bemiktzat hattaana. ushemuel – ketiv "hu" uchetiv "ze", dei kefar bemiktzat veodi bemiktzat – chayyayv.
Verav – chad lehodaa bemiktzat hattaana, vechad lehodaa mimmin hattaana. ushemuel – lav mimmela shamat minneh dechasra la taana?

Ella amar lecha rav: "kesef" ki ata meikkara – lichfira hu daata; deim ken, lichtov rachamana: "ki yitten ish el reehu kelim lishmor" – vaana amena: ma kelim shenayim, af kol shenayim; "kesef" dichtav rachamana lema li? im eno inyan letaana, tenehu inyan lichfira.
Ushemuel amar lach: i ketav rachamana "kelim" vela ketav "kesef", hava amena: may kelim shenayim, af kol shenayim – aval davar chashuv la baenan; ka mashma lan.
Tenan: "shete kesef yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella peruta" – patur. may tama? lav mishshum dechasra lah taana – uteyuveta dishmuel?
Amar lecha shemuel: mi savrat shave katane?! davka katane – ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano.

I hachi, ema sefa: "shete kesef uferuta yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella peruta" – chayyayv. i amrat bishlama shave – mishshum hachi chayyayv; ella i amrat davka – ammay chayyayv? ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano!
Midde hu tama – ella lishmuel; haamar rav nachman, amar shemuel: teano chittin useorin vehoda lo beechad mehen – chayyayv.

Hachi name mistabbera – middekatane sefa: "litra zahav yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella litra kesef" – patur. i amrat bishlama davka katane – mishshum hachi patur; ella i amrat shave – ammay patur? litra tuva have!
Ella middesefa davka, resha name davka.
Lema tehve teyuveta derav? amar lecha rav: kulla matnitin – shave, velitra zahav shane.

a: Teda, deka tane sefa: "dinar zahav li beyadecha", "en lecha beyadi ella dinar kesef uteresit ufunedyon uferuta" – chayyayv, shehakkol min matbea [achat] hen. i amrat bishlama shave – mishshum hachi chayyayv; ella i amrat davka – ammay chayyayv?
Amar rabbi elazar: beshetteano bedinar matbeot, veka mashma lan difruta bichlal matbea ita. dayka name, dekatane: shehakkol min matbea achat.
Verav – shehakkol din matbea achat.
Verabbi elazar – lema middesefa kishmuel metaretz, resha name kishmuel sevira leh?
La; sefa davka, dekatane "shehakkol min matbea achat"; veresha – kerav o kishmuel.
Ta shema: "dinar zahav zahuv li beyadecha", "en lecha beyadi ella dinar kesef" – chayyayv. tama daamar leh "zahav zahuv", ha setama – shave kaamar leh!
Amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: kol haomer "dinar zahav", keomer "dinar zahav zahuv" dame.
Tane rabbi chiyyay lesayyoeh lerav: "sela li beyadecha", "en lecha beyadi ella sela chaser shete kesef" – chayyayv, "chaser maa" – patur.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar shemuel: lo shanu ella betaanat malve vehodaat love; aval taanat malve vehaadaat ed echad, afillu lo teano ella bifruta – chayyayv.

May tama? dichtiv: "lo yakum ed echad beish lechol avon ulechol chattat" – lechol avon ulechol chattat hu deeno kam, aval kam hu lishvua. vetanya: kol makom sheshshenayim mechayyeyvin oto mamon, ed echad mechayyeyvo shevua.
Veamar rav nachman amar shemuel: teano chittin useorin, vehoda lo beechad mehen – chayyayv.
Amar lo rabbi yitzchak: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan. mikkelal diflig aleh resh lakish? ikka deamri: mishha hava shahe leh veshatek leh, ikka deamri: mishta hava shate leh ushetek leh.
Lema mesayyay leh: teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin – patur. verabban gamliel mechayyev. tama ditano chittin vehoda lo bisorin, ha chittin useorin vehoda lo beechad mehen – chayyayv!
La; hu haddin daafillu chittin useorin name patur; vehay dekamippalgi bechittin – lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel.
Ta shema: teano kelim vekarkaot; hoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, bekarkaot vechafar bakkelim – patur.
b: Hoda bemiktzat karkaot – patur. bemiktzat kelim – chayyayv.
Tama dechelim vekarkaot – dekarka lav bat shevua hi; ha kelim vechelim dumeya dechelim vekarkaot – chayyayv!
Hu haddin daafillu kelim vechelim name patur; veha dekatane kelim vekarkaot – ka mashma lan dechi hoda bemiktzat kelim, chayyayv af al hakkarkaot.
May ka mashma lan? zokkin?! tenena: "zokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut lishshava alehen"!
Ha ikkar, hahi aggav gerara nasva.

Verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: teano chittin useorin, vehoda lo beachat mehen – patur. vehaamar rabbi yitzchak: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan! amorae ninhu allibba derabbi yochanan.
Ta shema: teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin – patur, verabban gamliel mechayyev. tama ditano chittin vehoda lo bisorin; ha chittin useorin vehoda lo beechad mehen – chayyayv!
Hu haddin daafillu chittin useorin name patur, vehay dekatane hachi – lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel.

Ta shema: teano kelim vekarkaot; vehoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, bekarkaot vechafar bakkelim – patur. hoda bemiktzat karka – patur. bemiktzat kelim – chayyayv. tama dechelim vekarkaot – dekarka lav bat shevua hi; ha kelim vechelim dumeya dechelim vekarkaot – chayyayv!

Hu haddin daafillu kelim vechelim name patur; veha kamashma lan – dehoda bemiktzat kelim, chayyayv af al hakkarkaot. may ka mashma lan? zokkin?! tenena: zokkin et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut, lishshava alehen! ha ikkar, hahi aggav gerara nasva.
Etiveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: teano shor vehoda lo bese, se vehoda lo beshor – patur. teano beshor vase vehoda lo beechad mehen – chayyayv.
Amar leh: ha manni – rabban gamliel hi. i rabban gamliel, afillu resha name!
Ella ha manni – admon hi; vela dachoye medachena lach, ella talmud aruch hu befiv shel rabbi yochanan: ha manni – admon hi.
Amar rav anan amar shemuel: teano chittin, vekadam vehoda lo bisorin – im kemaarim, chayyayv. im bemitkavven, patur.
Veamar rav anan amar shemuel: teano shete mechatin vehoda lo beachat mehen – chayyayv; lefichach yatzu kelim lema shehen.
Amar rav pappa: teano kelim uferuta, vehoda bakkelim vechafar bapperuta – patur. hoda bapperuta vechafar bakkelim – chayyayv.
Chada kerav, vachada kishmuel. chada kerav – deamar: kefirat taana shete kesef. chada kishmuel – deamar: teano chittin useorin vehoda lo beachat mehen – chayyayv.
"Mane li beyadecha", "en lecha beyadi" – patur. amar rav nachman: umashbiin oto shevuat hesset. may tama? chazaka en adam tovea, ella im ken yesh lo alav.
Adderabba, chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo! ishtemote hu deka mishtemit leh, savar: ad dehave li ufarana leh.
Tidda, deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda: hakkofer bemilve – kasher leedut. befikkadon – pasul leedut.
Rav chaviva matne assefa – "mane li beyadecha", amar lo "hen"; lemachar amar lo "tenehu li", "netattiv lach" – patur. veamar rav nachman: mashbiin oto shevuat hesset.
Man dematne aresha – kol shekken assefa;

a: Uman dematne la assefa – hacha hu deikka derara demamona, aval hatam delekka derara demamona – la.
May ikka ben shevua deorayyta lishvua derabbanan? ikka benayyhu mefach shevua – bidorayyta la mappechinan shevua, bidrabbanan mappechinan.

Ulemar bar rav ashe, deamar bidorayyta name mappechinan shevua – may ikka ben deorayyta lidrabbanan? ikka benayyhu mechat lenichseh – bidorayyta nachatinan lenichseh, bidrabbanan la nachatinan lenichseh.
Ulerabbi yose, deamar bidrabbanan name nachatinan lenichseh?

Ditnan: metziat cheresh shote vekatan, yesh bahem gazel mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer: gazel gamur. veamar rav chisda: gazel gamur – middivrehem. lemay nafka minna? lehotzio bedayyaynin. may ikka ben deorayyta lidrabbanan?
Ikka benayyhu shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua; bidorayyta – shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, afchinan leh shevua (vesamu) aiddach; bidrabbanan – takkanta hi, vetakkanta letakkanta la avdinan.
Ulerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yose, deamru bidrabbanan la nachatinan lenichseh – may avdinan leh? meshammetinan leh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hay nakteh bechuveseh denishbekeh liglimeh hu! ella may avdinan leh? amar leh: meshammetinan leh ad demate zeman nigdeh, venagdinan leh veshavkinan leh.
Amar rav pappa: hay man deappek shetara al chavreh, veamar leh: shetara peria hu – amrinan leh: lav kol keminnach, zil shallem. veim amar: lishteva li, amrinan leh: ishteva leh.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: uma ben ze lefogem et shetaro?

Amar leh: hatam, af al gav dela taen ihu – taaninan leh anan; hacha, amrinan leh: zil shallem leh, vei taen veamar ishteva li – amrinan leh: zil ishteva leh. vei tzureba merabbanan hu – la mashbeinan leh.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: tzureba merabbanan mashlach gelima deinashe?! ella la mizdakkinan leh ledineh.

"Mane li beyadcha" kulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: hammalve et chavero beedim – tzarich leforo beedim. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li, yachol lomar lo: "peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni, vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam".
Tenan: "mane li beyadcha", amar lo "hen"; lemachar amar lo: "tenehu li", "netattiv lach" – patur. veha hacha, kevan detaveh beedim – keman deozfeh beedim dame, vekatane patur!
b: Teyuveta derav assi!
Amar lecha rav assi: ana ki amri – hecha demeikkara ozfeh beedim, dela ledideh hemneh; hacha – ha hemneh.

Rav yosef matni hachi – amar rav yehuda, amar rav assi: hammalve et chavero beedim – eno tzarich leforo beedim. veim amar: "al tifraeni ella beedim" – tzarich leforo beedim. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: yachol lomar lo: "peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni, vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam".

Tenan: "mane li beyadcha", amar lo "hen"; amar lo: "al tittenehu li ella bifne edim"; lemachar amar lo "tenehu li", "netattiv lach" – chayyayv, mippene shetztzarich litten lo beedim. teyuveta dishmuel!

Amar lecha shemuel: tannae hi, detanya: "beedim hilviticha, beedim pera li" – o yitten, o yavi reaya shennatan. rabbi yehuda ben betira omer, yachol lomar lo: "peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni, vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam".
Parech rav acha: mimmay devishat halevaa kae? dilma bishat tevia kae – vehachi kaamar leh: "lav beedim hilviticha? beedim haya lecha leforeni!" aval bishat halevaa – divre hakkol chayyayv.

Amar rav pappe mishshemeh derava, hilcheta: hammalve et chavero beedim – tzarich leforo beedim. verav pappa mishshemeh derava amar: hammalve et chavero beedim – en tzarich leforo beedim, veim amar "al tifraeni ella beedim" – tzarich leforo beedim; veim amar lo: "peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni, vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam" – neeman.
Siman – reuven veshimon, detanu hilcheta, yazfi ufara, peloni ufeloni, aftze sitrae, behemanuta keve tere.

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "ki (parattan) [parat li], piran (li) beappe reuven veshimon". azal ufareh beappe tere mealma. amar abbaye: beappe be tere amar leh, beappe be tere pareh. amar leh rava: lehachi kaamar leh "beappe reuven veshimon" – ki hechi dela nidchayeh!
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "ki parat li, piran (li) beappe be tere detanu hilcheta". azal pareh ben dileh ledileh, ittenisu hanach zuze.
Ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: "in, kabbole kabbeltinhu minneh – derech pikkadon; veamena leheve gabbay pikkadon, ad demitremu be tere detanu hilcheta umekayyem tenaeh".

Amar leh: kevan deka modet devadday shekaltinhu minneh – peraon mealleya have; i amrat lekayyome tenaeh – zil ayytinhu. deha ana verav sheshet, ditnena hilcheta vesifra vesifre vetosefta vecholla talmuda.

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "hav li mea zuze deozeftach". amar leh: "lo hayu devarim meolam". azal ayyti sahadi deozfeh ufareh. amar abbaye: may nibud? inhu amri ozfeh, inhu amri pareh. rava amar: kol haomer "lo laviti" – keomer "lo parati" dame.

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "hav li mea zuze demassekna bach". amar leh: "lo peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni?" ato peloni ufeloni amri: "lo hayu devarim meolam". savar rav sheshet lememar: huchezak kafran, amar leh rava: kol milleta dela ramya aleh deinash – lav addateh.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "hav li shet mea zuze demassekna bach". amar leh: "vela perataycha mea kabbe

a: Aftze dekayymi beshitta shitta?" amar leh: "lav bearbea arbaa havo kayymi?" ato tere sahadi vaamaru: "in, bearbea arbaa havo kayymi". amar rava: huchezak kafran. amar rame bar chama: ha amrat kol milleta dela ramya aleh deinish lav addateh! amar leh rava: kitztzuta detara midkar dechiri inashe.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "hav li mea zuze demassekna bach, veha shetara". amar leh: "peraticha". amar leh: "hanhu sitrae ninhu". amar rav nachman: ittera shetara. rav pappa amar: la ittera shetara.

Ulerav pappa – may shena mehahu daamar leh lechavreh: "hav li mea zuze demassekna bach, veha shetara"; amar leh: "lav attore yehavt li, vaatet veittevt ammesachta – vekabbelt zuzach?" vaamar leh: "hanhu sitrae ninhu"; vaamar rav pappa: ittera shetara.
Hatam, kevan dekaamar "attore yehavt li umittore shaklat" – ittera shetara; hacha, emor sitrae ninhu.
May have ala? rav pappe amar: la ittera shetara. rav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: ittera shetara. vehilcheta: ittera shetara.

Vehane mille, defareh beappe sahadi vela iddechar leh shetara; aval pareh ben dideh ledideh – miggo deyachol lememar "lo hayu devarim meolam", yachol name lememar "sitrae ninhu", uchedaavimi bereh derabbi avahu.

Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "mehemnat li kol emat deamrat li la parana". azal pareh beappe sahadi. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: ha hemneh. matkef la rav pappa: nehi dehemneh tefe minnafsheh, tefe missahade mi hemneh?!
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "mehemnat li keve tere, kol emat deamrat la parana". azal pareh beappe telata. amar rav pappa: keve tere hemneh, keve telata la hemneh.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: emor deamri rabbanan deazlinan batar rov deot – hane mille leinyan umedana, dechamma dinfishi bekii tefe; aval leinyan edut – mea kitre, utere kima!
Lishshana acharina, hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "mehemnat li keve tere, kol emat deamrat la parana". azal ufareh beappe telata. amar rav pappa: keve tere hemneh, keve telata la hemneh.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: tere kima, umea kitre! vei amar leh "keve telata", vaazal pareh beappe be arbea – kevan dinchet ledeot, nechet ledeot.
En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan, veen mashbiin et hakkatan. may tama? amar kera: "ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor", veen netinat katan kelum.
Aval nishbain lekatan ulehekdesh. veha amrat resha: en nishbain al taanat shote vekatan!

Amar rav: beva betaanat aviv, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi; detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo. ketzad? amar lo: "mane leavicha beyadi veheechaltiv peras" – hare ze nishba, vezehu shennishba al taanat atzmo. vachachamim omrim: eno ella kemeshiv aveda, ufatur.
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov – let leh meshiv aveda patur?! amar rav: beshetteano katan.
Katan?! vehaamrat: en nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan! leolam gadol, veammay karu leh katan? dilgabbe mille daavu – katan hu.
I hachi, "taanat atzmo"?! taanat acherim hi! taanat acherim, vehodaat atzmo.
b: Kullehu name taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu!

Ella bidrabba kamippalgi – deamar rabba: mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava? chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo. vehay – bechulleh bae delichpereh, vehay dela kafreh – mishshum deeno meiz panav bifne baal chovo;
Uvechulleh bae delode leh, vehay dela odi leh – ishtemote hu deka mishtemit minneh, savar: ad dehave li zuze ufarana leh; verachamana amar remi shevua illaveh, ki hechi delode leh bechulleh.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: la shena bo vela shena bivno – eno meez, vehilkach lav meshiv aveda hu. verabbanan savri: befanav hu deeno meez, aval bifne beno meez; umiddelo meez – meshiv aveda hu.

Mi matzet mokmat la kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov?! ha katane resha: "mane leabba beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim dinar" – patur, mippene shemmeshiv aveda hu! hatam dela amar "bari li", hacha deamar "bari li".
Shemuel amar: "lekatan" – lippara minnichse katan, "lahekdesh" – lippara minnichse hekdesh.
Lekatan lippara minnichse katan – tenena: minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua! tarte lema li?
Ha kamashma lan – kidabbaye kashshisha; detane abbaye kashshisha: yetomin sheamru – gedolim, veen tzarich lomar ketannim; ben lishvua ben lezibburit.
Lehekdesh lippara minnichse hekdesh – tenena: minnechasim meshuebadim lo yipparu ella bishvua; uma li meshuebadim lehedyot, uma li meshuebadim legavoah?
Itzterich; salka datach amena: hedyot hu deadam ose kenuneya al hedyot; aval hekdesh, deen adam ose kenuneya al hekdesh – ka mashma lan.

Vehaamar rav huna: shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav, veamar: "mane lifloni beyadi" – neeman, chazaka en adam ose kenuneya al hekdesh! amri: hane mille shechiv mera, deen adam chote velo lo; aval gabbe bari, vadday chayyshinan.

Mishna veellu devarim sheen nishbain alehen: haavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot vehahekdeshot. en bahen tashlume chefel velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, shomer chinnam eno nishba, nose sachar eno meshallem.
Rabbi shimon omer: kodashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – nishbain alehen, vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – en nishbain alehen.

Rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehen bekarka veenan kekarka; veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad? "eser gefanim teunot masarti lach", vehalla omer: "enan ella chamesh". rabbi meir mechayyev shevua, vachachamim omrim: kol hamechubbar lekarka – hare hu kekarka.

En nishbain ella al davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan. ketzad? "bayit male masarti lach" vechis male masarti lach", vehalla omer: "eni yodea, ella ma shehinnachta atta notel" – patur. ze omer "ad hazziz" veze omer "ad hachallon" – chayyayv.
Gemara tashlume chefel menalan? detanu rabbanan: "al kol devar pesha" – kelal; "al shor" veal chamor" veal se" veal salma" – perat; "al kol aveda" – chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot – sheen metaltelin; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – sheaf al pi shehen mittaltelin, en gufan mamon; hekdesh – "reehu" ketiv.
Velo tashlume chefel velo arbaa vachamishsha. may tama? tashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana, velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa.
Shomer chinnam eno nishba. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan:

a: "Ki yitten ish el reehu" – kelal, "kesef o kelim" – perat, "lishmor" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot – sheen metaltelin; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon; hekdesh – "reehu" ketiv.

Nose sachar eno meshallem. menalan? detanu rabbanan: "ki yitten ish el reehu" – kelal, "chamor o shor o se" – perat, "vechol behema lishmor" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal kulei, ad hekdesh – "reehu" ketiv.
Rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehen kekarka veenan kekarka kulei. mikkelal derabbi meir savar: kol hamechubbar lakkarka eno kekarka?! addemippalgi bitunot, lippalgi bisrukot!
(Ella) amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: hacha baanavim omdot lehibbatzer kamippalgi; derabbi meir savar: kivtzurot damyayn, verabbanan savri: la kivtzurot damyayn.
En nishbain ella al davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal kulei. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella daamar leh "bayit" setam, aval amar leh "bayit ze male" – yedia taanteh.
Amar leh rava: i hachi, addetane sefa: ze omer "ad hazziz" veze omer "ad hachallon" – chayyayv; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – bevayit male", aval "bayit ze male" – chayyayv!
Ella amar rava: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyitanennu bedavar shebbemidda shebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, veyode lo bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan.

Tanya kevavteh derava: "kor tevua li beyadcha", vehalla omer "en lecha beyadi" – patur. "menora gedola yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella menora ketanna" – patur. "azora gedola yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella azora ketanna" – patur.
Aval amar lo: "kor tevua yesh li beyadcha", vehalla omer: "en lecha beyadi ella letech" – chayyayv. "menora bat eser litrin yesh li beyadcha", "en lecha beyadi ella bat chamesh litrin" – chayyayv.
Kelalo shel davar: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyitanennu bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, veyode lo bedavar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan.
"Kelalo shel davar" leetoye may? lav leetoye "bayit ze male"?
Umay shena menora gedola umenora ketanna? ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano! i hachi, bat eser bat chamesh name – ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano!
Amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: hacha bimnora shel chulyot askinan, deka mode leh minna.
I hachi, azora name nitne – velokme bidlayyfi! ella delayyfi la katane; hacha name – beshel chulyot la katane!
Ella amar rabbi abba bar memel: shane menora, hoil veyachol legorrah ulehaamidah al chamesh litrin.
Mishna hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon, amar lo: "sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo ki, ella sela hilvitani alav vesela haya shave" – patur.
"Sela hilviticha alav, veshekel haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo chi, ella sela hilvitani alav, ushelosha dinarim haya shave" – chayyayv.

"Sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo chi, ella sela hilviticha alav vesela haya shave" – patur. "sela hilvitani alav ushetayim haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo chi, ella sela hilviticha alav vachamishsha dinarim haya shave" – chayyayv.
Umi nishba? mi shehappikkadon etzlo. shemma yishshava ze, veyotzi halla et happikkadon.
b: Gemara aheyay? illema assefa – vetippok leh dishvua gabbe malve!
Amar shemuel: aresha. vechen amar rabbi chiyyay bar rav: aresha. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: aresha.

May resha? sefa deresha: "sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo ki, ella sela hilvitani alav ushelosha dinarin haya shave" – chayyayv. dishvua gabbe love hi, veshakluha rabbanan millove veshadyuha ammalve.

Vehasheta deamar rav ashe dekayyma lan ze nishba sheenah birshuto veze nishba kamma shave – hachi kaamar: mi nishba techilla? mi shehappikkadon etzlo. shemma yishshava ze, veyotzi halla et happikkadon.
Amar shemuel: hay man deozfeh alpa zuze lechavreh, umashken leh katta demaggala; avad katta demaggala – avad alpa zuze. aval tarte kattate – la.

Verav nachman amar: afillu tarte kattate: avad chada – avad chamesh mea, avad iddach – avad kulleh. aval katta unesacha – la. nehardae amri: afillu katta unesacha: avad nesacha – avad palga, avad katta – avad kulleh.
Tenan: "sela hilviticha alav veshekel haya shave", vehalla omer: "lo chi, ella sela hilvitani alav ushelosha dinarin haya shave" – chayyayv. lema leh: "ha kabbelteh"!
Matnitin bidfaresh, shemuel bidla paresh.

Lema ketannae: hammalve et chavero al hammashkon veavad hammashkon – yishshava veyittol et meotav. divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer, yachol hu sheyyomar lo: kelum hilvitani – ella al hammashkon; avad hammashkon, avdu meotecha.
Aval hammalve elef zuz bishtar, vehinniach mashkon beyado – divre hakkol: avad hammashkon avdu meotav.
Hechi dame? i deshave shiur zuze –

a: May tameh derabbi eliezer? ella lav bidla shave shiur zuze – uvedishmuel ka mippalgi?

La; bidla shave – kulle alma let lehu dishmuel; vehacha bidshave shiur zuze, uvidrabbi yitzchak ka mippalgi – deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon? shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka".
Im eno kone mashkon, tzedaka minnayin lo? mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon.
Lema derabbi yitzchak tannae hi? vetisbera?! emor deamar rabbi yitzchak – shemmishkeno shello bishat halevaa; mishkeno bishat halevaa mi amar?!
Ella mishkeno shello bishat halevaato – kulle alma la peligi deit lehu derabbi yitzchak. vehacha – bemishkeno bishat halevaato,
Uveshomer aveda kamippalgi; deittemar: shomer aveda – rabba amar: keshomer chinnam,
b: Verav yosef amar: keshomer sachar dame.
Lema derav yosef tannae hi? la; beshomer aveda – dechulle alma it lehu derav yosef; vehacha bemalve tzarich lemashkon ka mippalgi: mar savar mitzva ka aved, umar savar lav mitzva ka aved.

Lema ketannae: hammalve et chavero al hammashkon venichnesa shemitta, af al pi sheeno shave ella pelag – eno meshammet. divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: im haya mashkono keneged chovo – eno meshammet, veim lav – meshammet.
May "eno meshammet" dekaamar tanna kamma? ilema kenegdo – mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar: kenegdo name meshammet?! ella ammay tafes mashkon?
Ella lav keneged kullo – uvedishmuel ka mippalgi?
La; leolam kenegdo, uveha kamippalgi – tanna kamma savar: kenegdo; verabbi yehuda hannasi savar: kenegdo name meshammet. udeka amrat: lemay tafes leh mashkon? lezichron devarim bealma.
Hadaran alach shevuat haddayyaynin
Mishna kol hannishbain shebbattora – nishbain velo meshallemin. veellu nishbain venotlin: hassachir, vehannigzal, vehannechbal, veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua, vechenvani al pinkaso.

Hassachir – ketzad? amar lo: "ten li sechari sheyyesh li beyadcha"; hu omer: "natatti", vehalla omer: "lo natalti" – hu nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer: ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad? amar lo: "ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li beyadcha", vehu omer: "hitkabbalta dinar zahav".

Nigzal – ketzad? hayu meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno shello birshut; hu omer "kelyi natalta", vehu omer "lo natalti" – hu nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer: ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad? amar lo "shene kelim natalta", vehu omer "lo natalti ella echad".

Nechbal – ketzad? hayu meidim oto shennichnas tachat yado shalem veyatza chavul; veamar lo: "chavalta bi", vehu omer: "lo chavalti" – hare ze nishba venotel. rabbi yehuda omer: ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa. ketzad? amar lo: "chavalta bi shetayim", vehalla omer: "lo chavalti becha ella echat".
Shekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua – ketzad?

a: Achat shevuat haedut veachat shevuat happikkadon, vaafillu shevuat shav; haya echad mehen mesachek bekuveya, umalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit – shekkenegdo nishba venotel.
Hayu shenehen chashudin – chazra hashshevua limkomah, divre rabbi yose. rabbi meir omer: yachloku.

Vehachenvani al pinkaso – ketzad? lo sheyyomar lo: "ketov al pinkasi sheatta chayyayv li matayim zuz", ella omer lo: "ten livni satayim chittin", "ten lefoalay (sela) [besela] maot". hu omer "natatti", vehen omrim "lo natalnu" – hu nishba venotel, vehen nishbain venotlin.
Amar ben nannas: ketzad ellu veellu bain lide shevuat shav? ella hu notel shello bishvua, vehen notlin shello bishvua.

Amar lachenvani: "ten li bedinar perot", venatan lo; amar lo: "ten li oto dinar", amar lo: "netattiv lach unetatto beunepali" – yishshava baal habbayit shennatan lo et haddinar. amar lo: "ten li et happerot", amar lo: "netattim lach veholachtim letoch betcha" – yishshava chenvani. rabbi yehuda omer: kol shehapperot beyado – yado al haelyona.

Amar lashshulechani: "ten li bedinar maot", venatan lo; amar lo: "ten li et haddinar", amar lo: "natatti lecha unetatto beunepali" – yishshava baal habbayit. natan lo et haddinar; amar lo: "ten li et hammaot", amar lo: "netattim lach vehishlachta letoch kischa" – yishshava shulechani. rabbi yehuda omer: en derech shulechani litten issar ad sheyyittol dinar.

Keshem sheamru: happogemet ketubbatah – lo tippara ella bishvua; veed echad meidah shehi perua – lo tippara ella bishvua; minnechasim meshuebadim uminnichse yetomim – lo tippara ella bishvua; vehannifraat shello befanav – lo tippara ella bishvua. vechen hayyetomim – lo yipparu ella bishvua:

"Shevua shello pekadanu abba, vela amar lanu abba, shello matzinu ben shetarotav shel abba sheshshetar ze parua". rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: afillu nolad habben leachar mitat haav – hare ze nishba venotel. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im yesh edim sheamar haav bishat mitato: "shetar ze eno parua" – hu notel shello bishvua.

Veellu nishbain shello betaana: hashshuttafin, vehaarisin, vehaappotroppin, vehaishsha hannoset vehannotenet betoch habbayit, uven habbayit. amar lo: "ma atta toaneni?" "retzoni shettishshava li" – chayyayv.
Chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin – en yachol lehashebio. (nitgalgel) [nitgalgela] lo shevua mimmakom acher – megalgelin alav et hakkol. vehashsheviit meshammetet et hashshevua.
Gemara kol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin. menalan? deamar kera: "velakach bealav velo yeshallem" – mi shealav leshallem, lo shevua.

Veellu nishbain venotlin kulei. may shena sachir detakkinu le rabbanan demishteva veshakel? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halachot gedolot shanu kan. halachot? hane hilcheta ninhu?! ella ema: takkanot gedolot shanu kan.
Gedolot – mikkelal deikka ketannot?!

Ella amar rav nachman amar shemuel: takkanot kevuot shanu kan – akruha rabbanan lishvua mibbaal habbayit, veshadyuha assachir; mishshum kede chayyav. mishshum kede chayyav desachir – kansinan leh levaal habbayit?! baal habbayit gufeh nicha leh demishteva sachir veshakel, ki hechi (deittagrun) [delittagrun] leh poalin.
Adderabba, sachir nicha leh dilshetva baal habbayit, venifka, ki hechi delegreh baal habbayit! baal habbayit al kurecheh agar. sachir name al kurecheh mittegar! ella baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu.
Velittev leh bela shevua!
Kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit. velittev leh beedim! tericha leh milleta. velittev leh meikkara! shenehen rotzin behakkafa.
b: I hachi, afillu katzatz name! allema tanya: umman omer "shetayim katzatzta li", vehalla omer "lo katzatzti lecha ella achat" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya? ketzitza vadday midkar dechir leh.
I hachi, afillu avar zemanno name! allema tanya: avar zemanno velo natan lo – hare ze eno nishba venotel?
Chazaka en baal habbayit over beval talin". vehaamrat: baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu! hane mille – mikkamme delimte zeman chiyyuva hu; ki mate zeman chiyyuva – rame annafsheh umiddechar.
Vechi sachir over mishshum "bal tigzol"?! gabbe baal habbayit ikka tere chazake: chada deen baal habbayit over beval talin", vachada deen sachir meshahe secharo.

Amar rav nachman, amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shessecharo beedim, aval secharo shello beedim – mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo: "lo secharticha meolam", yachol lomar lo: "secharticha, venatatti lecha secharcha". amar leh rabbi yitzchak: yishar, vechen amar rabbi yochanan.
Mikkelal diflig aleh resh lakish? ikka deamri mishta hava shate leh veshatek leh, veikka deamri mishha hava shahe leh ushetek leh.

Ittemar name: amar rav menashsheya bar zevid, amar rav: lo shanu ella shessecharo beedim, aval secharo shello beedim – mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo: "lo secharticha meolam", yachol lomar lo: "secharticha, venatatti lecha secharecha".

Amar rame bar chama: kamma mealleya ha shemata! amar leh rava: may mealleyuta? im ken, shevuat shomrin dechayyev rachamana – hechi mashkachat la? mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo "lo hayu devarim meolam", yachol lomar lo "neensu"!
Deafked leh beedim. mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo "hechzartiv lach", yachol lomar lo "neensu"!
Deafked leh bishtara.
Mikkelal detarvayyhu sevira lehu: hammafkid etzel chavero beedim – en tzarich lehachezir lo beedim; bishtar – tzarich lehachezir lo beedim.

Kare rame bar chama aleh derav sheshet: "vayyasem david et haddevarim haelle belibbo". deashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel, amar leh: tane mar midde besachir? amar leh: in, tenena: sachir bizmanno – nishba venotel. ketzad – bizman sheamar lo: "sechartani velo natatta li sechari", vehalla omer: "secharticha venatatti lecha secharecha"; aval amar lo: "shetayim katzatzta li", vehalla omer: "lo katzatzti lecha ella echat" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Ha middesefa biraya have – resha belo reaya.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:

a: Resha vesefa biraya; reaya dilshallem katane, reaya dishvua la katane.

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba, shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel: yelammedenu rabbenu, umman omer: "shetayim katzatzta li", vehalla omer: "lo katzatzti lecha ella echat" – mi nishba? amar lahen: bezo yishshava baal habbayit, veyafsid umman; ketzitza vadday midkar dechiri inashe.

Ini?! veha tane rabba bar shemuel: katzatz – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, vei la mayyte reaya – paka. ammay? yishshava baal habbayit, veyafsid umman! amar rav nachman: litzdadin katane – o mevi reaya veyittol, o yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman.

Metivi: hannoten tallito leumman, umman omer: "katzatzta li shetayim", vehalla omer: "lo katzatzti lecha ella echat"; kol zeman shettallit beyad umman – al baal habbayit lehavi reaya. netanah lo bizmanno – nishba venotel. avar zemanno – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Bizmanno miha nishba venotel; ammay? yishshava baal habbayit veyafsid umman!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: kol zeman sheshshevua nota etzel baal habbayit – sachir nishba venotel.
He rabbi yehuda? ilema rabbi yehuda dematnitin, achmore ka machmar – ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer: ad shettehe sham miktzat hodaa!

Ella rabbi yehuda devarayyta – detanya: sachir, kol zeman shello avar alav zemanno – hare ze nishba venotel, veim lav – eno nishba venotel. veamar rabbi yehuda: ematay – bizman sheamar lo: "ten li sechari chamishshim dinar sheyyesh li beyadecha"; vehu omer: "hitkabbalt mehen dinar zahav", o sheamar lo: "shetayim katzatzta", vehalla omer: "lo katzatzti lecha ella echat";
Aval amar lo: "lo secharticha meolam", o sheamar lo: "secharticha venatatti lecha secharecha" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: ella katzatz – rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan?! hasheta hechi demachmir rabbi yehuda – mekilli rabbanan, hecha demekel rabbi yehuda – machmeri rabbanan?!
Veella may – rabbanan? veella ha detane rabba bar shemuel: katzatz – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan!
Ella amar rava: beha kamippalgi – rabbi yehuda savar: bidorayyta – avadu leh takkanta lesachir; uvidrabbanan – havay takkanta, vetakkanta letakkanta la avdinan.
Verabbanan savri: bidrabbanan name avdinan takkanta lesachir, uketzitza midkar dechir.

Nigzal ketzad? hayu meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno kulei. vedilma lo mishkeno? mi la amar rav nachman: hay man dinkit narga bideh, veamar: "ezil veekteleh ledikla diflanya", veishtechach diktil ushede – la amrinan dehu katleh?
Alma avid inish degazem vela aved, hacha name – degazem vela aved! ema "umishkeno". velichze may mishkeno? amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: betoano kelim hannittalin tachat kenafav.
Amar rav yehuda: rauhu shehitmin kelim tachat kenafav veyatza,
b: Veamar "lekuchin hen beyadi" – eno neeman. vela amaran ella baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor kelav, aval baal habbayit heasuy limkor et kelav – neeman. vesheen asuy limkor et kelav name – la amaran ella devarim sheen darkan lehatemin, aval devarim sheddarkan lehatemin – neeman.

Vesheen darkan lehatemin name – la amaran ella inish dela tzenia, aval inish ditznia – hayeynu orcheh. vela amaran ella ze omer "sheulin" veze omer "lekuchin", aval bignuvin – lav kol keminneh; leachzoke inish begannave la machzekinan.

Vela amaran ella bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, aval devarim sheen asuyin lehasheil ulehaskir – neeman. dishlach rav huna bar avin: devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, veamar "lekuchin hen beyadi" – eno neeman. ki ha derava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme, bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir.
Amar rava: afillu shomer nishba, afillu ishto shel shomer nishbaat. bae rav pappa: sechiro ulekito may? teku.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: teano bechasa dechaspa, may? chazena: i inish daamid hu, o inish dimheman hu demafkedi inashe gabbeh – mishteva veshakel. vei la – la.
Nechbal ketzad. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bimkom sheyyachol lechabbel beatzmo, aval bimkom sheeno yachol lechabbel beatzmo – notel shello bishvua.
Venechush dilma bechotel nitchakkech! tane rabbi chiyyay: shealta lo neshicha begabbo uven atztzile yadav. vedilma acher aved leh? delekka acher.
Ucheshennegdo chashud [vechulei], vaafillu shevuat shav. may "afillu shevuat shav"?
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya hanach, deit behu kefirat mamon; ella afillu ha name, dichfirat devarim bealma hu – la meheman.
Velitne name shevuat bittuy! ki katane, shevua dechi ka mishteva – beshikra ka mishteva; aval shevuat bittuy, deikka lememar divkusheta ka mishteva – la katane.
Tinach "ochal" velo ochal"; "achalti" velo achalti" may ikka lememar? tana shevuat shav

a: Vechol dedame leh.
Haya echad mehen mesachek bekuveya. ha tu lema li? tena pesula deorayyta, vekatane pesula derabbanan.
Hayu shenehen chashudin. amar leh rava lerav nachman: hechi tenan? amar leh: la yadana. hilcheta may? amar leh: la yadana.

Ittemar: amar rav yosef bar minyome, amar rav nachman, rabbi yose omer: yachloku. vechen tane rav zevid bar oshaya, rabbi yose omer: yachloku. ikka deamri: tane rav zevid amar rabbi oshaya, rabbi yose omer: yachloku. amar rav yosef bar minyome: avad rav nachman ovada – yachloku.
Chazra shevua limkomah. lehechan chazra? amar rabbi amme, rabbotenu shebbevavel amru: chazra shevua lesinay, rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael amru: chazra shevua lamchuyyav lah.

Amar rav pappa: rabbotenu shebbevavel – rav ushemuel, rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael – rabbi abba. rabbotenu shebbevavel rav ushemuel – ditnan: vechen hayyetomin, lo yipparu ella bishvua. vehavenan ba: mimman? illema millove – avuhon shakel bela shevua, veinhu bishvua?! ella hachi kaamar: vechen hayyetomin min hayyetomin – lo yipparu ella bishvua.
Verav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: lo shanu ella shemmet malve bechayye love; aval met love bechayye malve – kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua, veen adam morish shevua levanav.

Rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael rabbi abba – dehahu gavra dachataf nesacha mechavreh; ata lekammeh derav amme, yetev rabbi abba kammeh. ayyti chada sahada demichtaf chatfe minneh, amar leh: "in, chatafi – vedidi chatafi".

Amar rabbi amme: hechi lidayyeynu dayyayne lehay dina? nema leh "zil shallem" – lekka tere sahadi. niftereh – ikka chad sahada. nema leh "zil ishteva" – kevan deamar "michtaf chatafi", have leh kegazlan.
Amar leh rabbi abba: have mechuyyav shevua veen yachol lishshava, vechol hamechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Amar rava: kevavteh derabbi abba mistabbera, detane rabbi amme: "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" – velo ben hayyorshin. hechi dame?
Ilema deamar leh: "mane leabba beyad avicha", veamar leh: "chamshin it leh vechamshin let leh" – ma li hu uma li avuha?
Ella lav deamar leh: "mane leabba beyad avicha", amar leh: "chamshin yadana vechamshin la yadana"?
b: I amrat bishlama aviv ki hay gavvna michayyayv, itzterich kera lemiftar gabbe yorshin; ella i amrat aviv ki hay gavvna name patur, kera gabbe yorshin lema li?
Verav ushemuel – hay "shevuat Adonai" may ka darshi beh?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya, shimon ben tarfon omer: "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem" – melammed shehashshevua chala al shenehem.
Shimon ben tarfon omer: azhara laokev acher noef, minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo tinaf" – lo tanif.
"Vatteragnu beoholechem" – shimon ben tarfon omer: tartem veginnitem beoholo shel makom.
"Ad hannahar haggadol nehar perat" – shimon ben tarfon omer: kerav legabbe dehina, veiddehan. deve rabbi yishmael tana: eved melech – kemelech.
Vehachenvani al pinkaso kulei. tanya, amar rabbi: torach shevua zo lamma? amar lo rabbi chiyyay (bar abba), tenena: shenehem nishbain venotlin mibbaal habbayit.
Kibbela minneh, o la kibbela minneh? ta shema: detanya, rabbi omer: poalin nishbain lachenvani. veim ita, levaal habbayit mibbee leh!
Amar rava: poalim nishbain levaal habbayit – bemaamad chenvani; ki hechi delikkasfu minneh.
Ittemar: shete kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo – amar rav huna: zo baa bifne atzmah umeida, vezo baa bifne atzmah umeida. rav chisda amar: bahade sahade shakkare lema li?
Shene malvin ushene lovin ushene shetarot – hayeynu pelugetayyhu; malve velove ushene shetarot – yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona;
Shene malvin velove echad ushene shetarot – hayeynu matnitin; shene lovin umalve echad ushene shetarot – may? teku.
Metiv rav huna bar yehuda:

a: Echad omer gavoah shete mardeot veechad omer shalosh – edutan kayyemet. echad omer shalosh veechad omer chamesh – edutan betela, umitztarfin leedut acheret.
May, lav leedut mamon? amar rava: hu veacher mitztarfin leedut acheret shel rosh chodesh; dehave lehu tere vechad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.

Amar lachenvani "ten li bedinar perot" kulei. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay – bizman shehapperot tzevurin umunnachin, ushenehen orrin alehen; aval hifshilan bekuppato laachorav – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Amar lashshulechani "ten li" kulei. utzericha; dei ashmeinan ha kammayyta – behach ka amri rabbanan, mishshum defere avidi demarkevi, vechevan demarkevi la meshahu leh; aval maot dela markevi – ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda.
Vei ittemar beha – beha kaamar rabbi yehuda, aval behach ema mode lehu lerabbanan; tzericha.

Keshem sheamru happogemet ketubbatah [vechulei], vechen hayyetomin lo yipparu. mimman? ilema millove – avuhon shakel bela shevua, veinhu bishvua?! hachi kaamar: vechen hayyetomim min hayyetomim, lo yipparu ella bishvua.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: lo shanu ella shemmet malve bechayye love; aval met love bechayye malve – kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua, veen adam morish shevua levanav.

Shalchuha kammeh derabbi elazar: shevua zo – ma tivah? shelach lehu: yorshin nishbain shevuat yorshin, venotlin. shalchuha bime rabbi amme, amar: kulle hay shalchi la veazli? i ashkechinan ba tama, mi la shalchinan lehu?! ella amar rabbi amme: hoil vaata leyadan, nema ba milleta:
Amad baddin vamet – kevar nitchayyev malve livne love shevua, veen adam morish shevua levanav. lo amad baddin vamet – yorshin nishbain shevuat yorshin, venotlin.
Matkef la rav nachman: attu be dina ka mechayyeyvi leh shevua?! meiddana dishchev love, ichayyayv leh malve livne love shevua!

Ella amar rav nachman: i ita lidrav vedishmuel, ita; i leta, leta. alma mesappeka leh; vehaamar rav yosef bar minyome: avad rav nachman ovada – yachloku! lidvarav derabbi meir kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Metiv rav oshaya: meta – yorsheha mazkirin et ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim! hacha bemay askinan – shennishbea umeta.
Ta shema: nasa rishona vameta, nasa sheniyya umet hu – sheniyya veyorsheha kodmin leyorshe harishona! hacha name, shennishbea umeta.
Ta shema: aval yorshav mashbiin otah, veet yorsheha, veet habbain birshutah!
Amar rav shemaya, litzdadin katane: otah – bealmana, veyorsheha – bigrusha.
Metiv rav natan bar hoshaya: yafe koach habben mikkoach haav –
b: Shehabben gove ben bishvua uven shello bishvua, vehaav eno gove ella bishvua. hechi dame – demet love bechayye malve;
Vekatane: shehabben gove ben bishvua uven shello bishvua; bishvua – shevuat yorshin, shello bishvua – kerabban shimon ben gamliel!
Amar rav yosef: ha manni – bet shammay hi, deamri: shetar haomed ligbot – kegavuy dame.

Ikkela rav nachman lesura; ul legabbeh rav chisda verabba bar rav huna, amaru leh: lete mar nekera leha derav ushemuel. amar lehu: ikkafli vaatay kol hane parse, lemekera leha derav ushemuel?! ella havu dela losef ala; kegon may deamar rav pappa: happogem et shetaro vamet – yorshin nishbain shevuat yorshin, venotlin.
Hahu dishchev, ushevak arva. sevar rav pappa lememar: ha name – dela losef ala hu. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: attu arva lav batar yatme azel?!
Hahu dishchev, ushevak acha. savar rame bar chama lememar: ha name – dela losef ala hu. amar leh rava: ma li "shello pekadani abba", uma li "shello pekadani achi".
Amar rav chama: hasheta dela ittemar hilcheta la kerav ushemuel vela kerabbi elazar; hay dayyayna daavad kerav ushemuel – avad, daavad kerabbi elazar – avad.

Amar rav pappa: hay shetara deyatme – la mikra karinan leh, vela agboye magbinan beh. agboye la magbinan beh – dilma sevira lan kerav ushemuel, umikra la karinan leh – dehay dayyayna daavad kerabbi elazar, avad.

Hahu dayyayna daavad kerabbi elazar. hava tzureba merabbanan bemateh, amar leh: ayytina iggarta mimmareva, delet hilcheta kerabbi elazar. amar leh: lechi tayyte. ata lekammeh derav chama, amar leh: hay dayyayna daavad kerabbi elazar – avad.
Veellu nishbain. attu beshufetane askinan?! hachi kaamar: veellu nishbain shello betaanat bari ella betaanat shemma – hashshuttafin vehaarisin.
Tana: ben bayit sheamru – lo shennichnas veyotze beraglav; ella machnis lo poalin umotzi lo poalin, machnis lo perot umotzi lo perot.
Umay shena hane? mishshum demoru be hettera.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome, amar rav nachman: vehu sheyyesh taana benayyhu shete kesef.
Keman – kishmuel?! vehatane rabbi chiyyay lesayyoeh lerav! ema kefirat taana, kerav.
Chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin. ibbaya lehu: mahu legalgel bidrabbanan?
Ta shema: lava hemennu erev sheviit, ulemotzae sheviit naasa lo shuttaf o aris – en megalgelin. tama delava hemennu erev sheviit – daatay sheviit afkateh; ha shear shene shavua – megalgelin!
La tema: ha shear shene shavua – megalgelin; ella ema: naasa lo shuttaf o aris erev sheviit, ulemotzae sheviit lava hemennu – megalgelin.
Ha behedya katane la: naasa lo shuttaf o aris erev sheviit, ulemotzae sheviit lava hemennu – megalgelin! shema minna: megalgelin bidrabbanan! shema minna.
Amar rav huna:

a: Lakkol megalgelin, chutz missachir – sheen megalgelin. rav chisda amar: lakkol en mekillin, chutz missachir – dimkillin. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu liftoach lo.
Vehashsheviit meshammetet kulei. mena hane mille? amar rav giddel amar rav, deamar kera: "veze devar hashshemitta" – vaafillu dibbur meshammetet.
Hadaran alach kol hannishbain
Mishna arbaa shomrin hen: shomer chinnam vehashshoel, nose sachar vehassocher.
Shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol, vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol.
Nose sachar vehassocher – nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva.

Amar leshomer chinnam: "hechan shori?" amar lo: "met" – vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad; "nishbar" – vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad. "nishba" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad; "nignav" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad; "avad" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
"Hechan shori?" amar lo: "eni yodea ma atta sach" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o avad; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
"Hechan shori?" amar lo: "avad"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen"; vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo – meshallem et hakkeren. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.
"Hechan shori?" veamar lo: "nignav"; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen"; vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.

Amar leechad bashshuk: "hechan shori shegganavta?" hu omer: "lo ganavti", vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. raa edim shemmemashmeshin uvain, amar: "ganavti, aval lo tavachti velo macharti" – eno meshallem ella keren.
Amar leshoel: "hechan shori?" amar lo:
b: "Met" – vehu shennishbar o nishba o nignav o avad; "nishbar" – vehu shemmet o nishba o nignav o avad; "nishba" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nignav o avad; "nignav" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o avad; "avad" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
"Hechan shori?" amar lo: "eni yodea ma atta sach" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba o nignav o neevad; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv.

Amar lenose sachar vehassocher: "hechan shori?" amar lo: "met" – vehu shennishbar o nishba; "nishbar" – vehu shemmet o nishba; "nishba" – vehu shemmet o nishbar; "nignav" – vehu sheavad; "avad" – vehu shennignav; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.
"Met" o "nishbar" o "nishba" – vehu shennignav o avad; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – chayyayv. "avad" o "nignav" – vehu shemmet o nishbar o nishba; "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen" – patur.

Ze hakkelal: kol hameshanne mechova lechova, umippetur liftur, umippetur lechova – patur. mechova liftur – chayyayv. ze hakkelal: kol hannishba lehakel al atzmo – chayyayv. lehachemir al atzmo – patur.

Gemara man tena arbaa shomrin? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: rabbi meir hi. amar leh rava lerav nachman: mi ikka tanna delet leh arbaa shomrin?! amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: man tanna deamar socher kenose sachar dame? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: rabbi meir hi.
Veha rabbi meir ippecha shaminan leh – ditnan: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer chinnam, rabbi yehuda omer: kenose sachar! rabba bar avu ippecha tane.
Hane arbaa havu?! shelosha havu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: arbaa shomrin, vedinehen shelosha.

Amar leshomer chinnam kulei, "hechan shori" kulei, amar leechad bashshuk kulei, amar leshomer kulei, "hechan shori?" amar lo: "eni yodea ma atta sach" kulei. amar rav: vechullan peturin mishshevuat shomrin, vechayyayvin mishshum shevuat bittuy. ushemuel amar: af peturin mishshum shevuat bittuy.
Bemay kamippalgi? shemuel savar: leta bilhabba. verav savar: iteh belav vahen.

Veha ippeligu va chada zimna – deittemar: "shevua shezzarak peloni tzeror layyam", "shevua shello zarak" – rav amar: chayyayv, ushemuel amar: patur. rav amar chayyayv – deita belav vehen, ushemuel amar patur – deleta bilhabba!

Tzericha; dei ashmeinan beha – beha kaamar rav, mishshum deminnafsheh kamishteva; aval behach, deve dina mashbei leh – ema mode leh lishmuel, kidrabbi amme; deamar rabbi amme: kol shevua shehaddayyaynim mashbiin otah – en chayyayvin aleha mishshum shevuat bittuy.
Vei ittemar beha – beha kaamar shemuel, aval behach ema mode leh lerav; tzericha.

Gufa – amar rabbi amme: kol shevua shehaddayyaynin mashbiin otah, en bah mishshum shevuat bittuy; shenneemar: "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim" – meatzmo. kidresh lakish – deamar resh lakish: "ki" mishtammesh bearba leshonot: i, dilma, ella, deha.

Rabbi elazar omer: kullan peturin mishshevuat shomrin vechayyayvin mishshum shevuat bittuy; chutz meeni yodea ma atta sach" deshoel, ugeneva vaaveda denose sachar veshebbesocher – shehu chayyayv, shehare kefaro mamon.
Hadaran alach arbaa shomrin, uselika la massechet shevuot

a: Mishna lifnay edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim — asur laset velatet immahem, lehasheilan velishol mehen, lehalevotan velilvot mehen, leforan velifroa mehen. rabbi yehuda omer: nifrain mehen, mippene shemmetzer hu lo. amru lo: af al pi shemmetzer hu achshav, sameach hu leachar zeman.
Gemara rav ushemuel, chad tane "edehen", vechad tane "edehen". man detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, uman detane "edehen" la mishtabbash.
Man detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "ki karov yom edam", uman detane "edehen" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku".

Uman detane "edehen", may tama la tane "edehen"? amar lach: tevara adif. uman detane "edehen", may tama la tane "edehen"? amar lach: man ka garem lehu tevara? edut sheheidu beatzman, hilkach edut adifa.

Vehay "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" beummot haolam ketiv? ha beyisrael ketiv, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze baot umeidot lahem laolam habba, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" — ellu yisrael, "yishmeu veyomru emet" — ellu ummot haolam.
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: man deamar "edehen" — mehacha: "yotzre fesel kullam tohu vachamudehem bal yoilu veedehem hemma".
Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa, veittema rabbi simlay: leatid lavo mevi hakkadosh baruch hu sefer tora umannicho becheko, veomer: lemi sheasak bah yavo veyittol secharo.
Miyyad mitkabbetzin uvain ummot haolam beirbuveya, shenneemar: "kol haggoyim nikbetzu yachdav vegomer", omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: al tikkansu lefanay beirbuveya, ella tikkanes kol umma veummah
b: Vesofreha, shenneemar: "veyeasfu leummim", veen "leom" ella malchut, shenneemar: "uleom milleom yeematz". umi ikka irbuveya kamme hakkadosh baruch hu? ella ki hechi dela liarbevu inhu [bahade hadade], delishmeu may deamar lehu.

[Miyyad] nichnesa lefanav malchut romi techilla. may tama? mishshum dachashiva. umenalan dachashiva? dichtiv: "vetechul kol ara utedushinna vetaddekinna". amar rabbi yochanan: zo romi chayyevet shettivah yatza bechol haolam.

Umena lan deman dachashiv ayel beresha? kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: melech vetzibbur — melech nichnas techilla ledin, shenneemar: "laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael vegomer". vetama may? ibbaet ema: lav orach ara lemetav malka meabbaray, veibbaet ema: mikkamme delipposh charon af.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: bemay asaktem? omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, harebe shevavkim tikanneynu, harebe merchatzaot asinu, harebe kesef vezahav hirbenu, vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku betora.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: shotim shebbaolam, kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem, tikkantem shevavkim lehoshiv bahen zonot, merchatzaot leadden bahen atzmechem, kesef vezahav shelli hu, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot".
Kelum yesh bachem maggid zot? shenneemar: "mi vachem yaggid zot", veen "zot" ella tora, shenneemar: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe". miyyad yatzu befache nefesh.

Yatzat malchut romi, venichnesa malchut paras achareha. may tama? deha chashiva batra. umenalan? dichtiv: "vaaru cheva ochori tinyana damya ledov", vetane rav yosef: ellu parsiyyim, sheochlin veshotin kedov, umesurebalin [basar] kedov, umegaddelin sear kedov, veen lahem menucha kedov.

Omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: bemay asaktem? omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, harebe gesharim gasharnu, harebe kerakkim kavashnu, harebe milchamot asinu, vechullam lo asinu ella bishvil yisrael kede sheyyitasseku battora.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: kol ma sheasitem letzorech atzmechem asitem, tikkantem gesharim littol mehem meches, kerakkim laasot bahem angarya, milchamot ani asiti, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama", kelum yesh bachem maggid zot? shenneemar: "mi vachem yaggid zot", veen "zot" ella tora, shenneemar: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe", miyyad yatzu millefanav befache nefesh.
Vechi meachar dachazayt malchut paras lemalchut romi dela mahneya vela midde, may tama ayyla? amri: inhu satri bet hammikdash vaanan baninan, vechen lechol umma veuma.

Vechi meachar dachazo lekammae dela mahane vela midde, may tama ayyli? savri: hanach ishtabadu behu beyisrael, vaanan la shabadnu beyisrael. may shena hane dachashivi, umay shena hane dela chashivi lehu? mishshum dehanach mashchi bemalchutayyhu ad deate meshicha.

Omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum natatta lanu velo kibbalnuha? umi matze lememar hachi? vehachtiv: "vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo", uchetiv: "eloah mitteman yavo vegomer". may bae beseir, umay bae befaran?
Amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shehechzirah hakkadosh baruch hu al kol umma velashon, velo kibbeluha, ad shebba etzel yisrael vekibbeluha!

Ella hachi amri: kelum kibbalnuha velo kiyyaymnuha? veal da tevartehon, ammay la kabbeltuha? ella kach omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum kafita alenu har kegigit velo kibbalnuha, kemo sheasita leyisrael?

Dichtiv: "vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar", veamar rav dimi bar chama: melammed shekkafa hakkadosh baruch hu har kegigit al yisrael, veamar lahem: im attem mekabbelin et hattora — mutav, veim lav — sham tehe kevuratchem!
Miyyad omer lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: harishonot yashmiunu, shenneemar: "verishonot yashmiunu", sheva mitzvot shekkibbaltem hechan kiyyaymtem?

Umenalan delo kiyyeymum? detane rav yosef: "amad vaymoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim", may raa? raa sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehen bene noach velo kiyyeymum, kevan shello kiyyeymum amad vehittiran lahen. ittegore ittegur? im ken matzinu chote niskar!
Amar mar bereh deravina:

a: Lomar, sheaf al pi shemmekayyeymin otan en mekabbelin alehem sachar.

Vela? vehatanya: haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol? talmud lomar: "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem", kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim lo neemar, ella "haadam", ha lamadta sheafillu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol.
Ella lomar lach, sheen mekabbelin alehem sachar kimtzvvev veose, ella kemi sheeno metzvvev veose, deamar rabbi chanina: gadol hametzvvev veose yoter mishsheeno metzvvev veose.
Ella kach omrim haggoyim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yisrael shekkibbeluha hechan kiyyeymuha?

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: ani meid bahem shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah. omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh av shemmeid al beno? dichtiv: "beni bechori yisrael". amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: shamayim vaaretz yaidu bahem shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah.

Omrim lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shamayim vaaretz nogin beedutan, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti", (deamar) [veamar] rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom hashshishshi"? melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit, veamar: im yisrael mekabbelin et torati mutav, veim lav — ani achazir etchem letohu vavohu.
Vehayeynu deamar chizkiyya, may dichtiv: "mishshamayim hishmata din eretz yara veshakata"? im yara lamma shakta, veim shakta lamma yara? ella battechilla yara, ulevassof shakta.

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: mikkem yavou veyaidu bahen beyisrael shekkiyyeymu et hattora kullah, yavo nimrod veyaid beavraham shello avad avoda zara, yavo lavan veyaid beyaakov shello nechshad al haggazel, tavo eshet potifera vetaid beyosef shello nechshad al haavera.

Yavo nevuchadnetztzar veyaid bachananya mishael vaazarya shello hishtachavu latztzelem, yavo daryavesh veyaid bedaniyyel shello bittel et hattefilla, yavo bildad hashshuchi vetzofar hannaamati veelifaz hattemani veelihu ben barachel habbuzi veyaidu bahem beyisrael shekkiyyeymu et kol hattora kullah, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku".

Amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, teneha lanu merosh venaasenna. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: shotim shebbaolam! mi shettarach beerev shabbat yochal beshabbat, mi shello tarach beerev shabbat mehechan yochal beshabbat? ella af al pi chen, mitzva kalla yesh li vesukka shemah, lechu vaasu otah.
Umi matzet amrat hachi? veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom", hayyom laasotam velo lemachar laasotam, hayyom laasotam velo hayyom littol sachar.
Ella, sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitruneya im beriyyotav. veammay kare leh "mitzva kalla"? mishshum delet bay chesron kis.

Miyyad kol echad veechad notel veholech veose sukka berosh gaggo, vehakkadosh baruch hu makdir alehem chamma bitkufat tammuz, vechol echad veechad mevaet besukkato veyotze, shenneemar: "nenatteka et mosrotemo venashlicha mimmennu avotemo". makdir? veha amrat: en hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitruneya im beriyyotav! mishshum deyisrael name zimne
b: Demashcha lehu tekufat tammuz ad chagga, vehave lehu tzaara. vehaamar rava: mitztaer patur min hassukka! nehi defatur, baote mi mevaati?
Miyyad, hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umesachek alehen, shenneemar: "yoshev bashshamayim yischak vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: en sechok lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Ikka dematne leha derabbi yitzchak aha, detanya: rabbi yose omer: leatid lavo bain ummot haolam umitgayyeyrin. umi mekabbelinan minnayyhu? vehatanya: en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach, kayyotze vo lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo!
Ella shennaasu gerim gerurim, umannichin tefillin berashehen, tefillin bizrootehem, tzitzit bevigdehem, mezuza befitchehem.
Kevan sheroin milchemet gog umagog, omer lahen: al ma batem? omrim lo: al Adonai veal meshicho, shenneemar: "lamma ragshu goyim uleummim yehgu rik vegomer",

Vechol echad menattek mitzvato veholech, shenneemar: "nenatteka et mosrotemo vegomer", vehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umesachek, shenneemar: "yoshev bashshamayim yishchak vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu sechok ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: shetem esre shaot have hayyom, shalosh harishonot — hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora, sheniyyot — yoshev vedan et kol haolam kullo, kevan sheroe shennitchayyev olam kelayay — omed mikkisse haddin veyoshev al kisse rachamim,

Shelishiyyot — yoshev vezan et kol haolam kullo mikkarne remim ad betze chinnim, reviiyyot — yoshev umesachek im livyatan, shenneemar: "livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo", amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: im beriyyotav mesachek, veal beriyyotav eno mesachek ella oto hayyom bilvad.

Amar leh rav acha lerav nachman bar yitzchak: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en sechok lehakkadosh baruch hu. umenalan delekka sechok? illema middichtiv: "vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekorcha vegomer", dilma hahu yoma vetu la!

Ella dichtiv: "im eshkachech yerushalam tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi", dilma shichcha hu delekka, aval sechok miha ikka! ella meha: "hechesheti meolam acharish etappak vegomer".
