Birviiyyot may aved? yoshev umelammed tinokot shel bet rabban tora, shenneemar: "et mi yore dea veet mi yavin shemua gemule mechalav attike mishshadayim". lemi yore dea ulemi yavin shemua? ligmule mechalav uleattike mishshadayim.
Umeikkara man hava maygmar lehu? ibbaet ema: metatron, veibbaet ema: ha veha aved.

Uvelelya may aved? ibbaet ema: meen yemama, veibbaet ema: rochev al keruv kal shello veshat bishmona asar elef olamot, shenneemar: "rechev elohim ribbotayim alfe shinan", al tikre "shinan" ella "sheenan", veibbaet ema: yoshev veshomea shira mippi chayyot, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi".

Amar rabbi levi: kol happosek middivre tora veosek bedivre sicha maachilin lo gachale retamim, shenneemar: "hakkotfim malluach ale siach veshoresh retamim lachmam". amar resh lakish: kol haosek battora ballayla hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed bayyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi". ma taam "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo"? mishshum devallayla shiro immi.

Ikka deamri, amar resh lakish: kol haosek battora baolam hazze haddome lelayla — hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed baolam habba haddome leyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, may dichtiv: "vattaase adam kidge hayyam keremes lo moshel bo", lamma nimshelu bene adam kidge hayyam? lomar lach: ma dagim shebbayyam — kevan sheolin layyabbasha miyyad metim, af bene adam — kevan shepporshin middivre tora umin hammitzvot miyyad metim. davar acher: ma dagim shebbayyam — kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim, kach bene adam — kevan shekkadra alehem chamma miyyad metim.

Ibbaet ema baolam hazze, veibbaet ema laolam habba. ibbaet ema baolam hazze — kidrabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim, shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem".

Veibbaet ema laolam habba — kidrabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: en gehinnam leatid lavo, ella hakkadosh baruch hu motzi chamma minnartikah, umakdir, reshaim niddonin bah, vetzaddikim mitrappein bah, reshaim niddonin

a: Bah, dichtiv: "[ki] hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vehayu chol zedim vechol ose risha kash velihat otam hayyom hava amar Adonai tzevaot asher lo yaazov lahem shoresh veanaf", lo shoresh — baolam hazze, velo anaf — laolam habba.
Tzaddikim mitrappein bah, dichtiv: "vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha vegomer", velo od ella shemmitaddenin bah, shenneemar: "vitzatem ufishtem keegle marbek".

Davar acher: ma dagim shebbayyam — kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero, af bene adam — ilmale moraa shel malchut, kol haggadol mechavero bolea et chavero. vehayeynu ditnan: rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: heve mitpallel bishlomah shel malchut, sheilmale moraah shel malchut "ish et reehu chayyim balau".

Rav chinnana bar pappa rame, ketiv: "shadday lo metzanuhu saggi choach", uchetiv: "gadol adonenu verav koach", uchetiv: "yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach"! la kashya, kan bishat haddin, kan bishat milchama.

Rabbi chama berabbi chanina rame: ketiv "chema en li", uchetiv "nokem Adonai uvaal chema"! la kashya: kan — beyisrael, kan — beummot haolam. rav chinnana bar pappa amar: "chema en li" — shekkevar nishbati, "mi yitteneni" — shello nishbati, "ehye shamir vashayit vegomer".

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi alekkesanderi: may dichtiv "vehaya bayyom hahu avakkesh lehashemid et kol haggoyim", avakkesh mimmi? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: avakkesh benigne shellahem, im yesh lahem zechut — efdem, veim lav — ashmidem.

Vehayeynu deamar rava: may dichtiv: "ach lo vei yishlach yad im befido lahen shua"? amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: kesheani dan et yisrael, en ani dan otam keummot haolam, dichtiv: "avva avva avva asimenna vegomer", ella ani nifra mehen kefid shel tarnegolet.

Davar acher: afillu en yisrael osin mitzva lefanay ki im meat, kefid shel tarnegolin shemmenakkerin baashpa, ani metzarfan lecheshbon gadol, [shenneemar: "im befido] lahen shua", [davar acher]: bassachar shemmeshavvevin lefanay, ani moshia otam.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi abba: may dichtiv "veanochi efdem vehemma dibberu alay kezavim"? ani amarti efdem bemamonam baolam hazze, kede sheyyizku laolam habba, vehemma dibberu alay kezavim.

Vehayeynu deamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: may dichtiv "vaani yissarti chizzakti zerootam veelay yechashshevu ra"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti ayasserem beyissurin baolam hazze kede sheyyechzeku zerootam laolam habba, veelay yechashshevu ra.

Mishtabbach lehu rabbi avahu lemine berav safra, deadam gadol hu, shevaku leh michsa ditlesar shenin. yoma chad ashkechuhu, amaru leh: ketiv "rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama al ken efkod alechem et kol avonotechem", man deit leh sisya berachameh massek leh? ishtik vela amar lehu vela midde, remo leh sudara betzavvereh veka metzaaru leh.

Ata rabbi avahu ashkechinhu, amar lehu: ammay metzaaritu leh? amaru leh: velav amrat lan deadam gadol hu? vela yada lememar lan perusha dehay pesuka! amar lehu: emar daamari lechu betannae, bikrae mi amari lechu?
Amaru leh: may shena attun deyaditun? amar lehu: anan dishchichinan gabbechon — raminan annafshin umeayyeynan, inhu la meayyeyni.

Amaru leh: lema lan at! amar lehu: emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam shennoshe mishshene bene adam, echad ohavo veechad sono. ohavo — nifra mimmennu meat meat, sono — nifra mimmennu bevat achat.

Amar rabbi abba bar kahana: may dichtiv "chalila lecha measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha"? amar avraham lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, chullin hu measot kaddavar hazze lehamit tzaddik im rasha.
Vela? vehachtiv: "vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha"! betzaddik sheeno gamur.

Aval betzaddik gamur la? vehachtiv "umimmikdashi tachellu", vetane rav yosef: al tikre "mimmikdashi" ella "mimmekuddashay", ellu bene adam shekkiyyeymu et hattora mealef vead tav. hatam name, kevan shehaya beyadam limchot velo michu, havu lehu ketzaddikim sheenan gemurim.
Rav pappa rame, ketiv: "el zoem bechol yom", uchetiv: "lifne zamo mi yaamod"! la kashya, kan beyachid, kan betzibbur.

Tanu rabbanan: "el zoem bechol yom", vechamma zamo? rega. vechamma rega? achat mechamesh ribbo usheloshet alafim ushemone meot vearbaim ushemone beshaa, zo hi rega, veen kol beriyya yechola lechavven otah rega chutz mibbilam harasha, dichtiv beh:
b: "Veyodea daat elyon" — efshar daat behemto la hava yada, daat elyon mi hava yada?

May "daat behemto la hava yada"? beiddana dachazo leh dahava rechiv achamareh, amaru leh: may tama la rechavta assuseya? amar lehu: birtiva sheday leh. miyyad: "vattomer haaton halo anochi atoncha", amar la: litina bealma.

Amara leh: "asher rachavta alay"! amar la: akray bealma. amara leh: "meodcha vead hayyom hazze", velo od ella sheani osa lach rechivut bayyom veishut ballayla. ketiv hacha: "hahasken hiskanti", uchetiv hatam: "vattehi lo sochenet".

Ella may "veyodea daat elyon"? shehaya yodea lechavven otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah, vehayeynu dekaamar lehu navi: "ammi zechor na ma yaatz balak melech moav ume ana oto bilam ben beor min hashshittim vead haggilgal lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai".

Amar rabbi elazar, amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: ammi, reu kamma tzedakot asiti immachem shello kaasti alechem kol otan hayyamim, sheim kaasti alechem lo nishtayyer missonehem shel yisrael sarid ufalit, vehayeynu dekaamar leh bilam levalak: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zoem Adonai".

Vechamma zamo? rega. vechamma rega? amar ammemar, veittema ravina: rega kememreh. umenalan derega hava ritcheh? dichtiv: "ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono". veibbaet ema mehacha: "chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam".
Emat ratach? amar abbaye: bitlat shae kammayayta, ki chivvara karbalta detarnegola. kol shata veshata michvavr chayvra? kol shata it beh sureyayke summake, hahi shata let beh sureyayke summake.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metzaer leh hahu mina [bikrae], yoma chad nekat tarnegola [veokmeh ben kareh dearsa], veayyen beh, sevar: ki mata hahi shata elteh, ki meta hahi shata naymnem.
Amar: shema minna lav orach ara lemibad hachi, ["verachamav al kol maasav"] ketiv, uchetiv: "gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov".

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: beshaa shehammelachim mannichin kitrehen berashehen umishtachavin lachamma, miyyad koes [hakkadosh baruch hu]. amar rav yosef: la litzalle inish tzelota demusafe bitlat shae kammayayta deyoma beyoma kamma deresh shatta beyachid, dilma kevan demippekid dina, dilma meayyeyni beovadeh vedachafu leh middeche.
I hachi, detzibbur name! detzibbur nefisha zechuteh. i hachi, deyachid detzafra name la! kevan deikka tzibbura deka metzallu, la ka middeche.
Veha amrat: shalosh rishonot hakkadosh baruch hu yoshev veosek battora! efoch.

Veibbaet ema: leolam la tefoch, tora dichtiv ba "emet", dichtiv: "emet kene veal timkor" — en hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin, din dela ketiv beh "emet" — hakkadosh baruch hu ose lifnim mishshurat haddin.

(Yom, meid, taraf, baegel — siman.) gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam"? "hayyom laasotam" — velo lemachar laasotam, "hayyom laasotam" — velo hayyom littol secharan.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze, baot umeidot otam laolam habba, shenneemar: "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku yishmeu veyomru emet". "yittenu edehem veyitzdaku" — ellu yisrael, "yishmeu veyomru emet" — ellu ummot haolam.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol mitzvot sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze, baot vetorfot otam leummot haolam laolam habba al penehem, shenneemar: "ushemartem vaasitem ki hiv chochmatchem uvinatchem leene haammim", "neged haammim" lo neemar, ella "leene haammim", melammed shebbaot vetorfot leummot haolam al penehem laolam habba.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo asu yisrael et haegel ella litten pitchon pe levaale teshuva, shenneemar: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kol hayyamim vegomer".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: lo david rauy leoto maase, velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase, lo david rauy leoto maase, dichtiv: "velibbi chalal bekirbi",
Velo yisrael reuyin leoto maase, dichtiv: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti kol hayyamim", ella lama asu?

a: Lomar lach, sheim chata yachid — omrim lo: kelach etzel yachid, veim chatu tzibbur — omrim lo: kelach etzel tzibbur.

Utzericha, dei ashmoinan yachid — mishshum dela mefarsam chiteh, aval tzibbur dimfarsam chitayhu — ema la. vei ashmoinan tzibbur — mishshum dinfishi rachamayyhu, aval yachid dela allima zechuteh — ema la, tzericha.
Vehayeynu derabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv "neum david ben yishay uneum haggever hukam al"? neum david ben yishay shehekim ullah shel teshuva.

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze, mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba, shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha uchevod Adonai yaasfecha", vechol haover avera achat, melappafto umolichato leyom haddin, shenneemar: "yillaftu orchot darkam vegomer".
Rabbi elazar omer: keshura bo kechelev, shenneemar: "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah", "lishkav etzlah" — baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" — baolam habba.

Amar resh lakish: bou venachazik tova laavotenu, sheilmale hen lo chatu — anu lo banu laolam, shenneemar: "ani amarti elohim attem uvene elyon kullechem", chibbaltem maasechem — "achen keadam temutun vegomer".
Lememra dei la chatu la havo moldu? vehachtiv "veattem peru urevu"! ad sinay. besinay name ketiv "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem"! lesimchat ona.
Vehachtiv: "lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem vegomer"! leotan haomdim al har sinay.

Vehaamar resh lakish, may dichtiv: "ze sefer toldot adam vegomer"? vechi sefer haya lo leadam harishon? melammed shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu leadam harishon dor dor vedorshav, dor dor vachachamav, dor dor ufarnasav. kevan shehiggia ledoro shel rabbi akiva samach betorato venitatztzev bemitato, amar: "veli ma yakru reecha el [vegomer]".
Veamar rabbi yose: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu neshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "[ki lo leolam ariv velo lanetzach ekketzof] ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti"!
La tema anu lo banu laolam, ella kemi shello banu laolam. lememra dei la chatu la havo mayyti? vehachtiv parashat yevamot ufarashat nachalot!

Al tenay. umi ketivi kerae al tenay? in, dehachi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom hashshishshi"? melammed shehitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit, veamar: im mekabbelin yisrael et hattora — mutav, veim lav — achzir etchem letohu vavohu.
Metivi: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem", levattel mehem malach hammavet i efshar, shekkevar nigzera gezera.
Ha lo kibbelu yisrael et hattora ella kede shello tehe umma velashon sholetet bahen, shenneemar: "lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem ad olam".

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi yose omer: lo kibbelu yisrael et hattora ella kede shello yehe malach hammavet sholet bahen, shenneemar: "ani amarti elohim attem uvene elyon kullechem", chibbaltem maasechem, "achen keadam temutun".
Verabbi yose name, hachtiv "lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem ad olam", tova hu dehavya, ha mita ikka! (rabbi yose) amar lach: kevan delekka mita, en lecha tova gedola mizzo.
Vetanna kamma name, hachtiv: "achen keadam temutun", may mita? aniyyut, deamar mar: arbaa chashuvim kemetim, ellu hen: ani, suma, umetzora, umi sheen lo banim.
Ani, dichtiv: "ki metu kol haanashim", uman ninhu? datan vaaviram. umi metu? mihve havo! ella sheyyardu minnichsehem.
Suma, dichtiv: "bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam". metzora, dichtiv: "al na tehi kammet". umi sheen lo banim, dichtiv: "hava li vanim veim ayin meta anochi".

Tanu rabbanan: "im bechukkotay telechu", en "im" ella leshon tachanunim, vechen hu omer: "lu ammi shomea li [vegomer] kimat oyvehem achnia", veomer: "lu hikshavta lemitzvotay vayhi channahar shelomecha vegomer vayhi chachol zarecha vetzeetzae meecha vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem", amar lahen moshe leyisrael: kefuye tova bene kefuye tova, beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: "mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem", haya lahem lomar: ten atta.
Kefuye tova, dichtiv: "venafshenu katza
b: Ballechem hakkelokel". bene kefuye tova, dichtiv: "haishsha asher natatta immadi hi natna li min haetz vaochel".

Af moshe rabbenu lo remazah lahen leyisrael ella leachar arbaim shana, shenneemar: "vaolech etchem bammidbar arbaim shana", uchetiv: "velo natan Adonai lachem lev vegomer". amar rabba: shema minna la kae inish addateh derabbeh ad arbein shenin.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa, may dichtiv: "ashrechem zore al kol mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor"? ashrehem yisrael bizman sheoskin betora uvigmilut chasadim, yitzram masur beyadam veen hem mesurim beyad yitzram, shenneemar: "ashrechem zore al kol mayim", veen zeria ella tzedaka, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed", veen mayim ella tora, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim".
"Meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor", tana deve eliyyahu: laolam yasim adam atzmo al divre tora keshor leol vechachamor lemassooy.
Shelosha yamim asur laset velatet immahem vechulei. umi bainan kulle hay?
Vehatnan: bearbaa perakim bashshana, hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio: "immah macharti lishchot", "bittah macharti lishchot".
Veellu hen: erev yom tov haacharon shel chag, erev yom tov harishon shel pesach, veerev atzeret, veerev rosh hashshana, uchedivre rabbi yose haggelili — af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil!

Hatam delaachila, saggi bechad yoma. hacha dilhakrava, bainan telata yome. ulehakrava saggi bitlata yome? vehatnan: shoalin behilchot happesach kodem happesach sheloshim yom, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shete shabbatot.
Anan dishchichi mumin defasli, afillu bedukkin shebbaayin, bainan telatin yomin; inhu, dimchussar ever it lehu, bitlata yome saggi.
Deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin limchussar ever deasur livne noach? dichtiv: "umikkol hachay mikkol basar shenayim mikkol vegomer", amra tora: have behema shechayyin rashe evarim shellah.
Hay mibbee leh lemaote terefa dela! terefa millechayyot zera" nafka. hanicha leman deamar terefa enah yoledet,

a: Ella leman deamar: terefa yoledet, may ikka lememar? amar kera: "ittach" — bedomin lach. vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava? "tamim" ketiv beh.
Vedilma "tamim bidrachav" haya? "tzaddik" ketiv beh!
Dilma "tamim" bidrachav, "tzaddik" bemaasav hava? la salka datach denoach gufeh terefa havay, dei salka datach denoach terefa hava, amar leh rachamana: kevavtach ayyel, shalmin la teayyel?
Vehasheta denafka leh meittach", "lechayyot zera" lema li? i meittach" hava amena letzavvta bealma, vaafillu zaken vaafillu saris, ketav rachamana "zera".
Ibbaya lehu: "shelosha yamim" — hen veedehen, o dilma hen belo edehen?
Ta shema, rabbi yishmael omer: shelosha lifnehem ushelosha leacharehen asur. i salka datach hen veedehen, rabbi yishmael yom edehen chashshev lehu meikkara vechashshev lehu levassof?
Ayyeyde ditna "shelosha lifnehem", tena name "shelosha leacharehem".
Ta shema, deamar rav tachlifa bar avdimi amar shemuel: notzrim ledivre rabbi yishmael leolam asur, vei salka datach "hen veedehen", haikka arbaa vachamishsha deshare!
Allibba derabbi yishmael la kamibbaya li, dehen belo edehen, ki ka mibbaya li allibba derabbanan — may?

Amar ravina: ta shema, veellu hen edehen shel goyim: kalenda, setaruneyay, ukeratesim. veamar rav chanin bar rava: kalenda — shemona yamim acher tekufa, setaruneyay — shemona yamim lifne tekufa, vesimanach: "achor vakedem tzartani".
Vei salka datach hen veedehen, asra havu! tanna kulleh kalenda chad yoma hu chashev leh.
Amar rav ashe, ta shema: "lifnay edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim", vei salka datach hen veedehen, litne: "edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim"!
Vechi tema, hay dekatane "lifne edehen" — lemaote leachar edehen, litne: edam shel goyim shelosha yamim lifnehem! ella shema minna, hen belo edehen. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: mishshum harevavcha, o dilma mishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol"?
Lemay nafka minna? deit leh behema ledideh. i amrat mishshum harevavcha — ha ka marvavch leh, i amrat mishshum "ivver lo titten michshol" — ha it leh ledideh.
Vechi it leh la avar mishshum "ivver lo titten michshol"? vehatanya: amar rabbi natan:
b: Minnayin shello yoshit adam kos shel yayin lenazir, veever min hachay livne noach? talmud lomar: "velifne ivver lo titten michshol"; veha hacha, dechi la yahavinan leh, shakli ihu, vekaavar mishshum "lifne ivver lo titten michshol"!
Hacha bemay askinan? dekae bitre evre nahara. dayka name, dekatane "lo yoshit" vela katane "lo yitten", shema minna.

Ibbaya lehu: nasa venatan — may? rabbi yochanan amar: nasa venatan — asur. resh lakish amar: nasa venatan — muttar. etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: edehen shel goyim nasa venatan — asurin, may lav lifne edehen? la, edehen davka.
Ikka deamri, etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: edehen shel goyim — nasa venatan asur. edehen — in, lifne edehen — la! tanna, idde veidde, "edehen" kare leh.

Tanya kevavteh deresh lakish: kesheamru "asur laset velatet immahem" — lo asru ella bedavar hammitkayyem, aval bedavar sheeno mitkayyem — lo, vaafillu bedavar hammitkayyem nasa venatan — muttar. tane rav zevid bidve rabbi oshaya: davar sheen mitkayyem mochrin lahem, aval en lokchin mehem.

Hahu minaa deshaddar leh dinara kesarnaa lerabbi yehuda nesia beyom edo, hava yatev resh lakish kammeh. amar: hechi eeved? eshkeleh — azel umode, la eshkeleh — havya leh eva. amar leh resh lakish: tol uzerok oto levor befanav. amar: kol shekken dehavya leh eva! kilachar yad hu dekaamena.

Lehasheilan velishol mehen kulei. bishlama lehasheilan — deka marvavch lehu, aval lishol mehen — maote ka memaet lehu? amar abbaye: gezera lishol mehen attu lehasheilan. rava amar: kullah mishshum deazel umode hu.

Lehalevotam velilvot mehen. bishlama lehalevotam — mishshum deka marvavch lehu, ella lilvot mehen — ammay? amar abbaye: gezera lilvot mehen attu lehalevotam. rava amar: kullah mishshum deazel umode hu.

Leforan velifroa mehen kulei. bishlama leforan — mishshum deka marvavch lehu, ella lifroa mehen — maote memaet lehu? amar abbaye: gezera lifroa mehen attu leforan. rava amar: kullah mishshum deazel umode hu.
Utzerichi, dei tena laset velatet immahen, mishshum deka marvavch lehu veazel umode, aval lishol mehen, demaote ka memaet lehu — shappir dame.
Vei tena lishol mehen, mishshum dachashiva leh milleta, veazel umode. aval lilvot mehen, tzaara bealma it leh, amar: "tuv la hadri zuze".
Vei tena lilvot mehen, mishshum dekaamar: "beal karcheh mipperana", vehasheta miha azel umode, aval lippara mehen, detu la hadri zuze, ema tzaara it leh, vela azel umode — tzericha.
Rabbi yehuda omer: nifrain mehen kulei. velet leh lerabbi yehuda "af al pi shemmetzer achshav sameach hu leachar zeman"?

Vehatanya: rabbi yehuda omer: ishsha lo tasud bammoed, mippene shenniuul hu lah. umode rabbi yehuda besid sheyyechola lekappelo bammoed, shettofalto bammoed, af al pi shemmetzera achshav, semecha hi leachar zeman!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hannach lehilchot moed, dechullehu metzer achshav, (semecha) [sameach] leachar zeman. ravina amar: goy leinyan peraon leolam metzer.
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, detanya: rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: milve bishtar en nifrain mehen, milve al pe nifrain mehen, mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam.
Yatev rav yosef achoreh derabbi abba, veyatev rabbi abba kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, vehilcheta kerabbi yehuda.
Hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua — ha daamaran, kerabbi yehuda — detanya: hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom.

a: Rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yater al hayyetzia — noten lo et hayyetzia, veim hayyetzia yetera al hashshevach — noten lo et hashshevach.
Ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh. bishlama halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha itzterich, salka datach amena: yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim, ka mashma lan halacha keyachid.
Ella halacha kerabbi yehuda lema li? peshita, demachloket veachar kach setam — hilcheta kistam.
Machloket bevava kamma, usetam bevava metzia, ditnan: kol hameshanne — yado al hattachtona, vechol hachozer bo — yado al hattachtona.
Verav huna? mishshum deen seder lammishna, deikka lememar setam tena beresha, veachar kach machloket. i hachi, kol machloket veachar kach setam — lema en seder lammishna!
Verav huna? ki la amrinan en seder — bachada massechta, bitre massechate amrinan. verav yosef: kullah nezikin chada massechta hi.
Vei baet ema, mishshum dekatane la gabbe hilchata pesikata: kol hameshanne — yado al hattachtona, vechol hachozer bo — yado al hattachtona.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yomar adam lachavero "hanire shettaamod immi laerev". rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: omer adam lachavero "hanire shettaamod immi laerev". amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha.
Tanu rabbanan: hannishal lechacham vetimme — lo yishshael lechacham vitaher, lechacham veasar — lo yishshael lechacham veyattir.

Hayu shenayim, echad metamme veechad metaher, echad oser veechad mattir, im haya echad mehem gadol mechavero bechachma uveminyan — hallech acharav, veim lav — hallech achar hammachmir. rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: beshel tora hallech achar hammachmir, beshel sofrim hallech achar hammekel. amar rav yosef: hilcheta kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha.

Tanu rabbanan: vechullan shechazru bahen — en mekabbelin otan olamit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: chazru bahen bematmoniyyot — en mekabbelin otan, befarhesya — mekabbelin otan. ikka deamri: asu divrehem bematmoniyyot — mekabbelin otan,
b: Befarhesya — en mekabbelin otan. rabbi shimon verabbi yehoshua ben korcha omrim: ben kach uven kach mekabbelin, shenneemar: "shuvu banim shovavim". amar rabbi yitzchak ish kefar akko amar rabbi yochanan: hilcheta keoto hazzug.
Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: shelosha lifnehem ushelosha leacharehem — asur, vachachamim omrim: lifne edehen — asur, leachar edehen — muttar.
Gemara amar rav tachlifa bar avdimi amar shemuel: notzri, ledivre rabbi yishmael leolam asur.

Vachachamim omrim: lifne edehen asur, leachar edehen muttar kulei. chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma! hen belo edehen ikka benayyhu, tanna kamma savar: hen belo edehen, verabbanan batrae savri: hen veedehen.
Ibbaet ema: nasa venatan ikka benayyhu, tanna kamma savar: nasa venatan muttar, verabbanan batrae savri: nasa venatan asur.
Veibbaet ema: dishmuel ikka benayyhu, deamar shemuel: baggola en asur ella yom edam, tanna kamma it leh dishmuel, rabbanan batrae let lehu dishmuel.
Ibbaet ema: denachum hammadi ikka benayyhu. detanya, nachum hammadi omer: eno asur ella yom echad lifne edehen, tanna kamma let leh denachum hammadi, verabbanan batrae it lehu denachum hammadi.
Gufa, nachum hammadi omer: eno asur ella yom echad lifne edehen. amru lo: nishtakka haddavar velo neemar. vehaikka rabbanan batrae dekayymi kevavteh! man chachamim? nachum hammadi hu.
Tanya iddach: nachum hammadi omer: mochrin lahen sus zachar vezaken bammilchama. amru lo: nishtakka haddavar velo neemar.

Vehaikka ben betira dekae kevavteh, ditnan: ben betira mattir bassus. ben betira la mefalleg ben zecharim linkevot, ihu middeka mefalleg ben zecharim linkevot, kerabbanan sevira leh. ulerabbanan nishtakka haddavar velo neemar.

Tanya [iddach], nachum hammadi omer: hashshevet mitasser zera veyarak vezirin. amru lo: nishtakka haddavar velo neemar! vehaikka rabbi eliezer dekae kevavteh, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: hashshevet mitasseret zera veyarak vezirin! hatam bidginnunita.

Amar leh rav acha bar minyome leabbaye: gavra rabba ata meatrin, kol milleta deamar, amri leh: "nishtakka haddavar velo neemar". amar [leh]: ikka chada deavdinan kevavteh, detanya: nachum hammadi omer: shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla".
Amar [leh] bar minna dehahi, detalya beashle ravreve.

Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: shoel adam tzerachav veachar kach yitpallel, shenneemar: "tefilla leani chi yaatof velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho vegomer", en sicha ella tefilla, shenneemar: "vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade".
Rabbi yehoshua omer: yitpallel, veachar kach yishal tzerachav, shenneemar: "eshpoch lefanav sichi tzarati lefanav aggid".

Verabbi eliezer name, hachtiv: "eshpoch lefanav sichi"! hachi kaamar: "eshpoch lefanav sichi" — bizman shetztzarati lefanav aggid. verabbi yehoshua name, hachtiv: "tefilla leani chi yaatof"! hachi kaamar: ematay tefilla leani? bizman shellifne Adonai yishpoch sicho.
Mikkede kerae la kemar dayyki vela kemar dayyki, bemay kamippalgi?

Kiddaresh rabbi simlay [dedaresh rabbi simlay]: leolam yesadder adam shivcho shel makom veachar kach yitpallel, menalan? mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv: "Adonai elohim atta hachillota lehareot et avdecha vegomer", uchetiv batreh: "ebera na veere et haaretz hattova".

a: Rabbi yehoshua savar: yalfinan mimmoshe, verabbi eliezer savar: la yalfinan mimmoshe, shane moshe derav guvereh. vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze, ella shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla".

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, halacha: shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla". amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: af al pi sheamru shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla", aval im ba lomar besof kol beracha uveracha meen kol beracha uveracha — omer.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: af al pi sheamru shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla", im yesh lo chole betoch beto — omer bevirkat cholim, veim tzarich lefarnasa — omer bevirkat hashshanim.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: af al pi sheamru: shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla", aval im ba lomar achar tefillato, afillu keseder yom hakkippurim — omer.

Mishna veellu edehen shel goyim — kalenda, usetarnura, vekartesim, veyom genuseya shel malchehem, veyom halleda, veyom hammita, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol mita sheyyesh bah serefa — yesh bah avoda zara, vesheen bah serefa — en bah avoda zara. aval yom tiglachat zekano uvelorito, veyom sheala bo min hayyam, veyom sheyyatza mibbet haasurin, vegoy sheasa mishte livno — eno asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish bilvad.
Gemara amar rav chanan bar rava: kalenda — shemona yamim achar tekufa, setarnura — shemona yamim lifne tekufa, vesimanach — "achor vakedem tzartani vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: lefi sheraa adam harishon yom shemmitmaet veholech, amar: oy li! shemma bishvil shessarachti olam chashuch baadi vechozer letohu vavohu, vezo hi mita shenniknesa alay min hashshamayim. amad veyashav shemona yamim betaanit [uvitfilla].

Kevan sheraa tekufat tevet, veraa yom shemmaarich veholech, amar: minhago shel olam hu. halach veasa shemona yamim tovim. leshana haacheret asaan leellu uleellu yamim tovim. hu kevaam leshem shamayim, vehem kevaum leshem avoda zara.

Bishlama leman deamar: "betishri nivra haolam", yome zute chaza, yome ariche akkatti la chaza. ella leman deamar: "benisan nivra haolam", ha chaza leh yome zute veyome ariche! (dehave) zute kulle hay la chaza.

Tanu rabbanan: yom shennivra bo adam harishon, kevan sheshshaka alav chamma, amar: oy li, shebbishvil shessarachti olam chashuch baadi, veyachzor olam letohu vavohu, vezo hi mita shenniknesa alay min hashshamayim. haya yoshev betaanit uvoche kol hallayla, vechavva bocha kenegdo. kevan sheala ammud hashshachar, amar: minhago shel olam hu. amad vehikriv shor shekkarnav kodmin lefarsotav, shenneemar: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par makrin mafris".

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shor shehikriv adam harishon, keren achat hayta lo bemitzcho, shenneemar: "vetitav laAdonai mishshor par makrin mafris". "makrin" tarte mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "makran" ketiv.

Amar rav matna: romi sheasta kalenda, vechol haayayrot hassemuchot lah mishtabedot lah, otan ayayrot asurot o muttarot? rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: kalenda asura lakkol hi, rabbi yochanan amar: en asura ella leovdeha bilvad.
Tana kevavteh derabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru, romi asta kalenda, vechol ayayrot hassemuchot lah mishtabedot lah, hi atzmah enah asura ella leovdeha bilvad.
Setarnelaya ukeratesim, veyom genuseya shel malchehem, veyom shehumelach bo melech — lefanav asur, acharav muttar. vegoy sheasa (bo) mishte livno — en asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish.
Amar rav ashe: af anan name tenena, dekatane: yom tiglachat zekano uvelorito, veyom sheala bo min hayyam, veyom sheyyatza bo mibbet haasurin — en asur ella oto hayyom bilvad veoto haish.
Bishlama "oto hayyom" — leappoke lefanav uleacharav, ella "oto haish" leappoke may? lav leappoke meshubadav? shema minna.

Tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: yisrael shebbechutza laaretz ovde avoda zara betohora hen, ketzad? goy sheasa mishte livno vezimmen kol hayyehudim shebbeiro, af al pi sheochlin mishshellahen veshotin mishshellahen, veshammash shellahen omed lifnehem, maale alehem hakkatuv keillu achlu mizzivche metim, shenneemar: "vekara lecha veachalta mizzivcho".
Veema: ad deachel! amar rava: im ken, nema kera "veachalta mizzivcho", may "vekara lecha"? mishsheat keria! hilkach,
b: Kol telatin yomin, ben amar leh mechamat hillula uven la amar leh mechamat hillula — asur, mikkan veelach, i amar leh mechamat hillula — asur, vei la amar leh mechamat hillula — shere.
Vechi amar leh mechamat hillula, ad emat? amar rav pappa: ad teresar yarche shatta. umeikkara meemat asur? amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: mikki ramu seare baasinte.

Ulevatar teresar yarche shatta shere? veha rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya ikkela leve hahu goy levatar teresar yarche shatta, veshameh deodi, uferash vela achal! shane rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya, deadam chashuv hu.

Ukeratesim vechulei. may keratesim? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yom shettafsa bo romi malchut. vehatanya: keratesim veyom shettafsa bo romi malchut! amar rav yosef: shete tefisot tafsa romi, achat bime keleppatra malketa, veachat shettafsa bime yevanim.

Dechi ata rav dimi amar: telatin uteren kerave avadu romae bahade yavnae, vela yechalu lehu, ad deshattefinhu leyisrael bahadayyhu, vehachi atno bahadayyhu: i minnan malche — minnayychu hipparche, i minnayychu malche — minnan hipparche.
Ushelachu lehu romae leyavnae: ad haiddana avedna bikrava, hasheta naaved bedina. margalit veeven tova, ezo mehen yease basis lachavero? shelachu lehu: margalit leeven tova.
Even tova veinach, ezo mehen yease basis lachavero? even tova leinach. inach vesefer tora, ezo mehen yease basis lachavero? inach lesefer tora.
Shelachu lehu: [im ken] anan sefer tora gabban veyisrael bahadan. kefo lehu esrin veshet shenin, kamu lehu behemanutayyhu bahade yisrael, mikkan veelach ishtabadu behu.
Meikkara may derush, ulevassof may derush? meikkara derush "nisa venelecha veelcha lenegdecha", ulevassof derush "yaavor na adoni lifne avdo".

Esrin veshet shenin dekamu behemanutayyhu bahade yisrael mena lan? deamar rav kahana: keshechala rabbi yishmael bar yose, shelachu leh: rabbi! emor lanu shenayim ushelosha devarim sheamarta lanu mishshum avicha.

Amar lehu: mea ushemonim shana kodem shennecherav habbayit pashta malchut harshaa al yisrael, shemonim shana ad lo charav habbayit gazru tumea al eretz haammim veal kele zechuchit, arbaim shana ad lo charav habbayit galta sanhedrin veyashva lah bachanut.

Lemay hilcheta? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: lomar, shello danu dine kenasot. dine kenasot salka datach? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: beram zachur oto haish lattov, verabbi yehuda ben bava shemo, sheilmale hu nishtakkechu dine kenasot miyyisrael! "nishtakkechu"? ligresinhu!
Ella batlu dine kenasot miyyisrael, sheggazra malchut hareshaa shemad al yisrael: kol hassomech yehareg, vechol hannismach yehareg, veir shessomchin bah techarev, utechum shessomchin bo yeaker.

Ma asa rabbi yehuda ben bava? halach veyashav ben shene harim gedolim, uven shete ayayrot gedolot, ben shene techume shabbat, ben usha lishfaram, vesamach sham chamishsha zekenim: rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon verabbi elazar ben shammua, verav avya mosif: af rabbi nechemya.

Kevan shehikkiru bahem oyvim, amar lahem: banay, rutzu! amru lo: rabbi, veatta ma tehe alecha? amar lahem: hareni mutal lifnehem keeven sheen lah hofchin. amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shennaatzu legufo shelosh meot luleniot shel barzel, vaasauhu legufo kichvara.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: la tema dine kenasot, ella shello danu dine nefashot.
May tama? kevan dachazo dinfishi lehu rotzchin vela yachli lemedan, amaru: mutav nigle mimmakom lemakom, ki hechi dela lichayyeyvu.
Dichtiv: "veasita al pi haddavar asher yaggidu lecha min hammakom hahu", melammed shehammakom gorem.
Mea ushemonim, vetu la? vehatane rabbi yose berabbi:
